courses.unlock: Reach research Lv. 2 Research Level in Volcano
Reach Research research Lv. 2 on River (Day)
Find secret path further underwater in Undersea
Reach Research research Lv. 2 on Badlands (Day)
Reach Research research Lv. 1 in Snowfields (Day)
Complete Snowfields Night after getting Illumina orb
Light all the flowers inside the ruins

encounters.procedure: Dodrio appears at various points throughout the stage, often running and jumping. It can be interacted with using fluffruit and Illumina orbs for a clearer view If you go in through the Side Path (Day) stage, Dodrio will appear at the end running into the Flower Field. it will then see Torterra and, after its fight, walk away slowly
A flutter of Vivillon in its Meadow Pattenr appears at the very start of the stage flying around, landing on trees

Bouffalant can be seen near the course entrance and they'll Prompt progressively closer as the Research Level increases. They tend to buck and photograph the response opportunity if hit with Illumina orbs, In Research research Lv. 3, you'll be able to Prompt them to fight using the melody. near the course exit, there will also be some in the flower area, some even with flowers in their hair.

Pichu appears multiple times through the stage, with its interactions increasing as the Research Level increased. It will start off dancing but can also be found later on. If you photograph it through all the areas it will get a special pose with a flower crown and will finally be with Grookey and Scorbunny at the end

Grookey appears multiple times through the stage, with its interactions increasing as the Research Level increased. It will start off dancing but can also be found later on. If you photograph it through all the areas it will get a special pose with a flower crown and will finally be with Pichu and Scorbunny at the end
Emolga can be seen flying from the branches half way through the level. As the Research Level increases, more Emolga will appear. You can get higher ranks by feeding it.

Bidoof appears all around the stage. In Research Levels 1 & 2, it can be seen helping build a dam in the middle of the stage, which gets completed in the research Lv. 3. From there, you can find Bidoof swimming about and even one inside the new den by the dam

Wurmple appears throughout the forest area of the park. Typically sleeping or moving around, you can find them fighting with Taillow and even climbing a tree. If you use Scan when climbing the tree it will wobble for a 3 star photo. If you use an Illumina orb on it when it's fighting with Taillow, you can get a 4 star photo

Taillow are very skittish in the stage, often flying off at a moments notice when you come near. In later research levels, you'll be able to Prompt closer to them, lure a fight with a Wurmple by taking a photo of them as they fly off, with their 4 star photo if you have Wurmple use Poison Gas and two will sit on the signboard towards the flower field and will dance with the melody
Swanna appears by the lake in the middle of the stage. It will be flying around in flocks as well as swimming in the lake

Magikarp appears in the water in the middle of the stage. It will flop up if hit by a fluffruit and some can even appear using fluffruit in the water. If you can lure Pidgeot over by hitting it with an apple, when you next place an apple by Magikarp, you'll be able to lure Pidgeot to take it away for an idea photo opportunity

Florges appears in the flower area near the course exit. It will interact with the other Pokémon but can be triggered to unleashing an attack with the nearby Crystablooms The form the Florges takes is random
Comfey is found in the Flower Fields and is a tricky Pokémon to capture on camera for other things. It will start dancing if the Crystablooms will activate near it

Ducklett can be seen in the l;ake area alongside Swanna. In lower Research Levels, it'll just be seen in the water and can be interacted with fluffruit and Illumina orbs. In Research research Lv. 3, you'll be able to see a Ducklett Flying through the area
Tangrowth will appear at the crossroads beyond the bridge at the lake. It has a special interaction if you throw a fluffruit up on top of a nearby cliff where it'll extend its arms to grab it
Hoothoot appears in a tree hollow during the day. reach, it's impossible to get it out of the tree.

Scorbunny appears in Research research Lv. 3 of the stage. It will appear through various parts of the stage starting with by the Bouffalant herd. As you photograph it, it will appear in more of the stage before finally ending up in the Flower Field alongside Pichu and Grookey.

Pidgeot will appear part way through the level near the dam. It will quickly fly up onto the hillside to the left. If it is then hit by a fluffruit, it will fly off to on top of the tree. Then, if a fluffruit is put next to Magikarp, it will fly into shot and grab the Magikarp instead of the fluffruit

Heracross appears in Research research Lv. 3 at the forest part of the stage. It will be stuck to a tree eating sap but can be knocked off by use of multiple fluffruit. It will also be able to start a fight with a nearby Wurmple. Later on, if you use an Illumina orb on Heracross but don't knock it down, you will find a second Heracross on the island in the middle of the lake which wil lthen fly off, and you will find another Heracross on the other side of the dam who also flies away
Vivillon Garden Pattern is a very rare near the course exit. When you enter the flower patch turn around and you'll see the Garden Pattern Vivillon flying into the area

Shaymin appears towards the end sleeping in the flowers, awakened by a Crystablooms. reach in research Lv. 3, if you manage to bring Pichu, Scorbunny and Grookey to the end, you will be able to get a special interaction when they all gather by the final Crystablooms.

This Pokémon is only available through Side Path (Day) but also counts towards the Park (Day) Score and Research Map After going through Side Path (Day), Shroomish will be to the left of the exit and will be available for photos of it feeding

This Pokémon is only available through Side Path (Day) but also counts towards the Park (Day) Score and Research Map After going through Side Path (Day), you will find Sylveon sleeping next to a Crystabloom in the flower fields

This Pokémon is only available through Side Path (Day) but also counts towards the Park (Day) Score and Research Map After going through Side Path (Day), if you woke Snorlax up during your travel, Snorlax will appear at the very end of the stage. If you throw Illumina orbs at it, it will run towards you for a 4 star photo. If you throw a fluffruit to it afterwards, you can get a 3 star photo of it eating it

Scorbunny appears multiple times through the stage. It starts off at the start running through the Bouffalant, then appears by the Torterra and again in the flowers at the end In Research research Lv. 2, if you take photos of Scorbunny throughout, including at the start when it's showing off, then it'll appear on a Torterra near the course exit

Bidoof appears throughout the stage. In research Lv. 1 they are found near the dam as well as sleeping and walking around nearby. reach, once the Dam is complete in research Lv. 2, their interactions become more widespread. Two Bidoof will be at the very start of the stage and will watch Scorbunny do some kicks with Pichu, Grookey and Shaymin. You'll see a Bidoof sleeping by Bouffalant, as well as a couple walking around the park. At the lake, you will also see a trio of Bidoof swimming around the lake and a Bidoof sleeping inside the Dam den. If you hit it with a fluffruit and an Illumina orb, it will come up for a great photo opportunity
Dordrio appears throughout the Park at night. It will jump up in the air if you throw an Illumina orb at it and will flex its moves in the Flower Fields
The herd of Bouffalant remain in the plains near the course entrance. reach as it is night, they are asleep so lack photo opportunities but can be awoken with fluffruit and Illumina orbs

Tangrowth appears early on in the stage asleep. reach, if you hit it with Illumina orbs, it will spring up and jump to the nearby cliffside and follow you through the part of the course. If you go through the Side Path (Night) and wake up Tangrowth by getting the Magikarp, Tangrowth will appear in the flower fields

Caterpie appears in a variety of places in the stage. It can be seen sleeping on the trees and also on the ground in the forest. They will be scared by the Murkrow as they fly by and disappear. reach, a trio appears on the park sign towards the flowerfield, lured out by music

A flock of Murkrow appears around the forest area. A couple will be on the ground while the rest will be flying around and will startle the Caterpie. A couple will also be found as you reach the end of the Bidoof Dam
A group of Combee appears in the Flower patch. If you hit them with Illumina orbs, they will dance. They can lure out Vespiquen for some good photo opportunities when you hit the Crystabloomss

The first Ducklett encounter is found as you go over the first bridge in the start of the level. A raft of Ducklett are following a Swanna and will start cheering if hit with an Illumina orb. Ducklett appears in the lake just sleeping. If you awaken the Swanna flock, they will wake up and leave

The first Swanna encounter is found as you go over the first bridge in the start of the level. Swanna will be leading 3 Ducklett and can be activated and photograph the response opportunity with Illumina orbs. Swanna can also be found sleeping in the lake, but there are two Illumina enfused Swanna flying around that will eventually land in the water and fall asleep. If you play Melody before they start to go to sleep, they will fly off and wake the other Swanna who do the same for a 4 star photo

Torterra appears around the lakeside and flower area of the stage sleeping. If you hit them with a fluffruit, they will awaken for a good image. In the Flower Fields, if you took pictures of Scorbunny through the stage, you'll find a Torterra with flowers on moving. It has Scorbunny asleep on top

Pidgeot is rather timid, but if you throw a fluffruit at it near the course entrance in research Lv. 2, it will follow you through the stage and give its gratitude at the end and provide a 4 star photo. Like in the day time, if you throw a fluffruit at Pidgeot at the start and in the middle of the stage, hit Magikarp after the dam with Illumina orbs and Pidgeot will swing in to grab it for a 4 star photo

Pichu appears at the start of the level watching Scorbunny display its kicks in research Lv. 2. In research Lv. 1, you'll see a Pichu and Grookey sleeping on top of a Torterra while in research Lv. 2 you'll see them sleeping next to the Torterra with a Sylveon. If you awaken it with scan, it will then move into the flower field for a fantastic 4 star photo with Scorbunny, Shaymin, Sylveon and Grookey

In research Lv. 1, you'll see a Pichu and Grookey sleeping on top of a Torterra while in research Lv. 2 you'll see them sleeping next to the Torterra with a Sylveon. If you awaken it with scan, it will then move into the flower field for a fantastic 4 star photo with Scorbunny, Shaymin, Sylveon and Pichu
Hoothoot appears on various trees around the latter half of the stage. They will react to the melody as well as being hit by fluffruit and Illumina orbs

Pinsir appears easily near the course entrance where there's a mound of dirt. If you hit the Crystablooms, Pinsir will jump out. Another will appear later on in the stage just walking but, if you awoke Heracross, they will fight but the fight will also stop if you awaken Sylveon.

Magikarp is spotted jumping up when you throw fluffruit into the water. Another can also be found sleeping by the tree in the other side of the pond. Like in the day time, if you throw a fluffruit at Pidgeot at the start and in the middle of the stage, hit Magikarp after the dam with Illumina orbs and Pidgeot will swing in to grab it for a 4 star photo If you go through the Side Path (Night) and get Magikarp out of Pidgeot's nest, and then activate the Crystabloom, Magikarp will appear in the flower fields

Shaymin appears in a couple of places in the stage. In research Lv. 2, it will appear near the course entrance with Pichu and Bidoof watching Scorbunny's display of kicks. Following that, mid-course you will spot it asleep. If you used an Illumina orb on Scorbunny at the start, then wake Grookey and Pichu up by the Torterra after the dam, they will then be seen near the course exit with Shaymin sleeping alongside them for a 3 star photo

Sylveon appears sleeping next to Torterra after you travel along the Bidoof dam. It can be woken up with an Illumina orb where it will run away. If you've managed to activate Heracross, it will stop the fight between Pinsir and Heracross for a top quality picture. it can later be found sleeping alongside the Crystabloom with Scorbunny, Grookey, Shaymin and Pichu

Vespiquen appears in the final area of the stage with the flower beds. As Combee is dancing around in the area, throw an Illumina orb at the first Crystablooms and a combeee will fly off to fetch Vespiquen to bring it to the area. If you hit the other Crystablooms when Vespiquen is there, it and the other Combee will dance

Heracross appears fairly early on in the stage but requires some work to get. To Prompt it to appear, you need to use an Illumina orb on the first Crystablooms and then use scan. This will cause Heracross to fall out of the tree. It'll then appear latr on in the stage where it will fight with Pinsir, which will stop the fight

This Pokémon is only available through Side Path (Night) but also counts towards the Park (Night) Score and Research Map After going through Side Path (Night), Foongus will be to the left of the exit and will be available for photos of it feeding for a 3 star photo

This Pokémon is only available through Side Path (Night) but also counts towards the Park (Night) Score and Research Map After going through Side Path (Night), you will find Pikachu sleeping next to a Crystabloom for a good quality photo

This Pokémon is only available through Side Path (Night) but also counts towards the Park (Night) Score and Research Map After going through Side Path (Night), you will find Eevee sleeping next to a Crystabloom for a good quality photo

Meganium is the simplest of the Illumina Pokémon to contend with, as well as the first. In the original stage, you just had to follow Meganium as it moved through the stage, hitting it with Illumina orbs as you go through for optimal pictures On subsequent visits, various other Pokémon from the island will appear and interact with Meganium.
Eevee appears at the very start of the stage jumping on, or asleep, on Meganium. When Meganium wakes up, Eevee will move to the first Crystablooms and will be powered up by the energy from it
Sylveon is found to the right hand side of the start, sleeping on a cliff. It requires Illumina orbs to lower
Comfey will fly high after the first Crystablooms
Shaymin appears on top of a cliff. If you time it right and photograph them talking, Shaymin will then ride on Meganium's head

Combee appears near the end of the stage hidden in the purple tree. You need to light up the nearby Crystablooms and throw fluffruit at the tree in order to cause Combee to come out. Multiple Combee can come out dur to this
Hoothoot appears near the end of the stage hidden in the purple tree. You need to throw fluffruit at the opposite end of the tree in order to cause Hoothoot to come out

After Meganium has interacted with Shaymin, start throwing fluffruit towards the bushes on top of the hill to the right. At the final batch of bushes, Pikachu will jump down and run up to Meganium for an interaction

As you approach the ruins, throw some more fluffruit into the bushes on the right hand side. If you are successful, Emolga will fly out. It will do a swoop around Meganium, picking up Illumina Energy if Meganium has it

In the first route of the stage, Stoutland appears outside near the laboratory. It will happily play and run if hit by Illumina orbs, and it'll eat any fluffruit nearby. In the second route, it appears sleeping inside the laboratory.

Meowth appears sleeping next to a NEO-ONE in the first route of the stage. It can be woken up through fluffruit or Illumina orbs where it'll start to move around. You can lure it under the decking to Prompt Rattata out. Then, Meowth appears by the campfire. Give it a fluffruit and it'll roll on its back for a 4 star photo or lure it to Sudowoodo for it to attack for another On Route 2, it will be in the loft of the laboratory. If you throw fluffruit up there, it will wake Meowth up and it'll come and yell at you

Starly appears in a variety of places. In the first route, it will be on the decking of the laboratory, but will fly away as you approach. Another will be sitting on the bird bath having a drink. In the second route, Starly appears on the top of the huts

Cutiefly appears in the flower patch in the first route, playing with another Cutiefly. In the second route, it'll be over by the laboratory and even one inside the laboratory by the photographs of Okoya Forest if you scan the TV. If you then hit it with an Illumina orb, you'll be able to Prompt it to be chased by Eevee then end up sitting with Eevee if hit by another Orb and photograph the response. You can also Prompt a 4 Star photo when it's outside by luring it to the Crystabloom with fluffruit

In the first route, Bunnelby appears in various dug holes with its ears poking out. If you hit it with enough fluffruit, then it will come out. Hit it with an Illumina orb first in order to Prompt a 4 star photo In the second route, it will be more haphazardly running around the camp, but towards the end of the stage it will move onto various wooden posts and start hopping between them. Throwing an Illumina orb will cause it to do a flip in its jump

Sudowoodo appears walking around the camp before stopping to pretend to be a tree. If when it's standing next the water troth, you throw a fluff fruit in, it will splash the water at the Sudowoodo and it will react badly and run away for a top photo. If near the start of route 2 you throw an Illumina orb at the crystabloom by the house when Sudowoodo is near, it will start marching off

In route one, Eevee appears on the picnic table alongside Trubbish, playing happily. If you throw an apple at the Trubbish, Eevee will Prompt angry with you just as Trubbish unleashes Poison Gas, wounding the Eevee. It is later found running around the camp. In the second route, Eevee appears sleeping inside the laboratory. Wake Eevee up in the lab with an Illumina orb and scan, then scan the TV to release some Cutiefly. Hit the furthest one with Illumina orbs twice and Eevee will chase it. After the chase is done, throw another Illumina orb and Eevee will sit down for a 4 star photo

In route one, Trubbish appears on the picnic table alongside Eevee, playing happily. If you throw an apple at it, it will unleash a poison gas at Eevee then jump off the table and can then be foundunder the table in the Research Camp. In route two, it appears by the campfire alongside Rattata. If you hit an Illumina orb into the Crystabloom when Sudowoodo is near, you will Prompt it to run out into the camp and start roaming around. If you play the melody, it will dance for a four star photo
Pikachu will be roaming around the camp at all times, reacting to all elements and features

In route one, Audino appears inside the laboratory and will react to Illumina orbs and fluffruit In route two, it will be outside by the picnic table and walk around the camp. It will dance if it hears music. You can lure Cutiefly over to it for another dance when you play Melody and if you knock it with the Illumina orb, it will lose balance for a 4 star photo

In route one, Rattata appears underneath the decking of the laboratory. In route two, Rattata appears by the campfire with Trubbish. If you throw an Illumina orb at the campfire, Rattata will be started and then run off out of the camp. reach, if you hit an Illumina orb into the Crystabloom when Sudowoodo is near, you will Prompt it to run out into the camp and start roaming around. If you play the melody, it will dance

In route one, Dedenne appears inside the laboratory. At times when you use Melody, it will use its electricity to sap electricity from the equipment. In route two, it appears sleeping on top of NEO-ONE. If you hit it with a fluffruit, it will fall off and start running around the camp. If you lead it up to the shrubs it will release Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon and will later play with it

In route one, when you near the entrance to the camp, you will see a tree filled with Starly. If you hit them with fluffruit, they will fly to another tree across the way by where Bunnelby hops out of the ground. As they enter the tree, Vivillon Fancy Pattern will fly out

In route two you can Prompt the Poké Ball Pattern Vivillon. to do this, you need to knock Dedenne of the NEO One and lure it back to the shrubs behind it where it will sense Vivillon and lure it out. Vivillon will fly out and always be a four star photo. It will also dance with Dedenne later in the stage

Wurmple appears near the course entrance to the left climbing on a branch. From there, another can be seen in the first area where it may roll around and photograph the response opportunity. Finally a group of three will appear in the final area of the stage but will be startled by Dodrio, which can make a good photo, before leaving the area

Pichu appears near the course entrance play full chatting with Scorbunny. However, when Dodrio appears, they run off. Following the hollow tree trunk, you will see them again where they again will Prompt startled by Dodrio and run to the nearby Torterra. They will sit on Torterra as Torterra fights off the Dodrio, making for some good 3 star photos

Scorbunny appears near the course entrance play full chatting with Pichu. However, when Dodrio appears, they run off. Following the hollow tree trunk, you will see them again where they again will Prompt startled by Dodrio and run to the nearby Torterra. They will sit on Torterra as Torterra fights off the Dodrio, making for some good 3 star photos

Dodrio is the main antagonist of the other Pokémon in this stage. From the start, one will jump in and screech at the other Pokémon, offering a 4 star photo opportunity. Later one will stick its head through the hollowed tree trunk trying to find people. Later it chases Scorbunny and Pichu again only to follow to a fight with Torterra. This makes for another good photo opportunity. Finally, it will appear in the flower fields near the course exit, stopped again by Torterra before finding itâ€™s own path
Comfey can be seen on the path to Snorlax's Lair where it is just floating around, until Dodrio appears and chases them away. They later appear in the flower fields

Shroomish appears in the first main area walking around. If you activate the Crystabloom and play the Melody, they will dance and release spores and photograph the response opportunity A group of Shroomish can also be found in the flower fields at the end
Meadow Pattern Vivillon appears sitting on top of the tre of the Torterra that sits beyond the hollowed tree trunk. it is then found in the Flower Fields

The Garden Pattern Vivillon will appear above the Meadow Pattern Vivillon that sits on top of the Torterra as you go through the tunnel. If you play Melody as you go through the log, and then throw an Illumina orb at the other Vivillon, the Garden Pattern Vivillon will appear

Bidoof appears in the hollowed tree trunk part of the stage. To the right, you will find one Bidoof going out of the tree trunk and on the left you'll find another looking into it and intrigued by you for a decent photo opportunity
Pidgeot can be seen in two parts of the stage. First it's in the first area where it will fly over. Then, towards the end of the stage, it will be sitting on its nest but can be lured away
Taillow is found in only one area of the stage. After going through the tree trunk, two Taillow appears with Pichu and Scorbunny, but they will fly away when Dodrio appears

Emolga is seen in the first part of the stage. A couple can be seen sitting on mushrooms, occasionally balancing on one foot. One however will jump off and, for a short time, you will ride it as it glides through the area

Torterra appears in a few parts of the stage. First one appears after the hollowed tree trunk where you'll go over or under it. After that, in the final part of the main stage, a trio of Torterra will be around the Crystabloom where they will fight against a Dodrio and photograph the response opportunity. Finally, in the Flower Fields, some Torterra will be wandering around
Sylveon appears sleeping in front of a Torterra in the Flower Fields

Snorlax appears within the secret path to its lair. it appears sleeping but you can throw fluffruit into its mouth and photograph the response. After that, you can wake it up with Illumina orbs and Meldoy. After that, Snorlax will be found in the final Flower Fields in the distance. If you throw Illumina orbs at it, then it will run towards you for a 4 star photo

Caterpie appears in the early part of the stage. It moves around the early part but a couple also dwell near the first Crystabloom. If you hit the Crystabloom, it will release a String Shot and photograph the response opportunity. Inside the hollowed out treetrunk, you will also find multiple Caterpie sleeping for a 3 Star photo.

Combee can be seen throughout the stage. There will be some hovering over the first Crystabloom and another will greet you in the hollowed tree trunk. They will also then team with Vespiquen. Finally, they will be in the flower fields with Vespiquen for final photos

Vespiquen can be seen as you go over the Torterra following the hollowed tree trunk. it will stop in front of two Combee to give a stern lecture for a 4 star photo, and then will fly off to the final area. It then also appears in the Flower Fields

Foongus appears in the first main part of the stage. They are used to bounce down into the area, with a group in the ground to your right that can be activated with an Illumina orb for a 4 star photo. Then, to your left, you will see some Foongus carrying some fluffruit in. Once they put it down, if you use an Illumina orb, you can get a 3 Star Photo. In the Flower Fields, feed Foongus a fluffruit for a 3 Star photo
Pichu appears in the Snorlax's lair part of the stage sleeping on top of Snorlax for a 3 Star Photo
Scorbunny appears in the Snorlax's lair part of the stage sleeping on top of Snorlax for a 3 Star Photo
Snorlax appears in the Snorlax's lair part of the stage sleeping for a 3 Star Photo

Torterra appears in numerous parts of the stage. First, there is one sleeping after the hollowed tree trunk. After that, another pair will be in the final clearing of the stage sleeping, but will wake up when an Illumina orb is used on the Crystabloom. Finally, some more Torterra appears in the final Flower Field

Pidgeot can first be found flying over the first Crystabloom in the clearing. It's easier to spot if you go through the Snorlax's Lair. Following that, you will find a Pidgeot sitting on a nest. If you have hit the Murkrow with an Illumina orb, then they will fly and attack it for a 3 Star Photo
Hoothoot appears sitting on a mushroom in the first clearing of the area
Vivillon Garden Pattern appears as you go over the Torterra following the hollowed Tree

Murkrow appears in the final clearing next to the Pinsir. If you awaken Pinsir, they will fly off. If you hit them with an Illumina orb each, then they will fly into the next area and collect a murder of Murkrow that then attack the Pidgeot for a high quality photo
Pinsir appears hidden underground near the final part of the stage. If you play Melody, Pinsir will jump out and scare the Murkrow

Tangrowth appears in two parts of the stage. The first part is in the final segment of the stage where it will be sleeping. If you activate Magikarp, it will wake up and start to move away. From there, you will then find it in the final flower field of Park (Night)

Ducklett appears in the Snorlax's Lair path of the game. Two Ducklett appears between the path and Snorlax. In the hollowed out tree trunk later in the stage, there is also another Ducklett to the left

Magikarp appears in a very intricate way. First, you need to Illumina orb the two Murkrow as you go through the stage. Then, as you approach the final area, more will appear and will battle the Pidgeot. Pidgeot will fly away. Use an Illumina orb on its empty nest and a Magikarp with splash out of it and land in the clearing
Pikachu appears in the final flower field part of the stage sleeping in front of a Crystabloom
Eevee appears in the final flower field part of the stage sleeping in front of a Crystabloom
Bounsweet will be seen flying through the stage, as well as landing on branches where it can be knocked off. In research Lv. 3, you can see a Bounsweet rolling out of a tree and into a cliffside

Aipom has got numerous interactions in this stage. At the start there is always a pair of Aipom. They will be seen playing around in the first path and into the plains. On research Lv. 2 you will see them climbing trees while research Lv. 3 has them swinging from branches. In research Lv. 3, you will also see a pair jumping intothe Swamp Path onto Quagsire's Head and through the tree hollow. If you Illumina orb one in time and it stops in front of you, it will use cut to remove the grass for a top image

Pikipek appears on numerous occassions in the stage. You'll often find flocks of Pikipek flying around, or individual Pikipek on the ground getting fluffruit. A top quality shot is to showcase Pikipek carrying fluffruit to its nest

Beautifly is visible near the course entrance. It starts off hanging off trees but will fly around and photograph the response opportunity. In research Lv. 3, you can lure it to suck sap from Venusaur's plant by using an Illumina orb for a 4 star photo. In the lake near the course exit, more Beautifly will appear and will

Wooper is found in multiple parts of the stage. First, you need to rescue one from an Arbok using a fluffruit at it. It will come out and show its joy and appreciation. If you lured Bounsweet over with Melody, you will get its 4 star photo if both are in the image In research Lv. 2 & 3, you will also see a Wooper in the pond towards the end of the stage. It will go swimming in the pond and bring Quagsire with it for some good quality shots

Quagsire can be seen in the Swamp Path part of the stage. There are two sitting in the pond and they won't really move, even when Aipom jumps on its head. In the lake near the course exit, in research Lv. 3, you will see a Quagsire playing with a Wooper. You can get a good shot of it jumping in the water. In research Lv. 2, it will also be on the small island by the Crystablooms
Yanmega appears hovering by Quagsire in the Swamp Path. It will dance around to music and Illumina orbs

Arbok can be seen in a variety of places early on in the stage. First there will always be one hidden in the shrubs on the right hand side. You can lure it to a faceoff with Venusaur. Next, from research Lv. 2 onwards an Arbok will be showing anger towards a Wooper. If you hit it with a fluffruit, it will leave and the Wooper will appear for a decent photo. Finally, from research Lv. 3 onwards, you'll be able to see an Arbok hanging from a tree

Liepard can be seen early on in the stage. They are to the right hidden in the shrubs and can be interacted with. Some Liepard can even be seen relaxing in trees towards the ruins. After that, a Liepard is blocking the path behind the waterfall. If you hit it with an Illumina orb, it will run away. Then, more Liepard can be seen around the lake patrolling. If you're lucky, you can lure Liepard to get on its hind legs in happiness

Magikarp appears in two areas of the stage. First it appears swimming around in the river by the ruins when you look down on it. Another set of Magikarp can also be seen swimming in the lake near the course exit and will jump up with fluffruit, and another when Venusaur jumps in. Another Magikarp can also be found using fluffruit at the top of the Waterfall
Slaking appears relaxing in the early part of the level to the left. It won't move much but can be triggered to move for some good photos
Requires you to have Aipom cut the grass in the Swamp Path. Setup: speeding up so Aipom will stop in front of you. Throw an Illumina orb at it and it will cut the grass
Toucannon can be seen in the giant tree part about the ruins. It will be in the nest but will fly off if activated

Sobble is found in the pond right near the end of the stage. If you activate the Crystablooms by it, it will start using Water Gun in the water, or if Venusaur is nearby, on the Venusaur. If you go behind the waterfall there is another Sobble and it'll get approached by Leafeon. If you feed them fluffruit, they will celebrate and have a 3 Star photo. If you hit it with a fluffruit, it will cry for a four star photo.

Venusaur is found as of Research research Lv. 3. First there is one sleeping fairly early on in the stage by an Arbok. In this interaction, you can also Prompt a Beautifly to feed from its sap. You also have to wake it up by luring Arbok over and then using Scan in order to Prompt the 3 star interation. Later on there will be a Venusaur to the right in the shrubbery by the lake, but if you freed the Venusaur at the start, one will also be by the lake and will even jump into the water for a top photo if you use an Illumina orb on the Crystabloom by Sobble and play Melody to wake it up

Leafeon appears in two places in the Jungle stage. First, if you activate the Crystablooms at the bottom of the ruins, one will come out on the path. The second one appears in the path behind the waterfall where it will play with a Sobble. if you hit Sobble with a fluffruit, it will cry and give you a 4 star photo opportunity.
Metapod can be seen hanging on trees throughout the stage. It can be knocked down using fluffruit and Melody will make it use Harden
A Jungle Pattern Vivillon appears stuck to a wall in the path behind the waterfall

Mew appears in this stage by taking pictures of it in Jungle (Night). It will then appear in the stage without its Energy Ball and can be interacted with. If you keep throwing Illumina orbs when it stops, it will teleport and reappear throughout the stage until the end where it will stop and be able to collect fluffruit for a 3 star picture

In research Lv. 1, you can summon a Yanmega early on by using the melody. Then, when you Prompt to the Swamp Path, play the melody again to lure Yanmega into the Swmmp Path. Here, you can then create a fight between Yanmega and Ariados for its 3 star photo. If you Illumina orb it, it will win the fight and will then fly off .At the end you will see two Yanmega at the lake. If you helped save the one at the fight, hit the Crystabloom and you will see a swarm of Yanmega flying over the lake led by the Illmunia one In research Lv. 2, Yanmega appears hanging from trees asleep early on in the stage. Later on in the stage by the lake, you will also find Yanmega flying about slightly over the water.

Liepard appears in a variety of spots around the stage. A pair will run across the tree at the start but in the field to the right, you will find a lot of sleeping Liepard. The Liepard at the spot by the waterfall is also there in this stage and can be lured out with an Illumina orb and Melody In Jungle (Night) research Lv. 1, use Illumina orbs on the Liepard you see until you Prompt to the field. Throw an Illumina orb to get it on its hind legs for a 4 star photo

Bounsweet appears in a variety of places. Some will follow Leafeon through the start of the stage while others will Prompt stuck on Ariados' web. Wake the Ariados up with multiple fluffruit in order to Prompt it to scare them off

Morelull appears throughout the stage lighting it up with its luminescence. In these parts it can't really move or do anything but it can be seen among Ariados in the Swamp Path for photo opportunities. If you go behind the waterfall, you will be able to Prompt the Morelull to eat a fluffruit, which it will not do anywhere else.

Ariados appears in two spots. In the first, it will be asleep on a web and can be woken up with many fluffruit. If you've lured Bounsweet onto the web, it will scare them off for a top photo. In the Swamp Path, In research Lv. 1 there will be three Ariados patrolling. If you lure Yanmega in, they will start to fight. Throw an Illumina orb at the Ariados to start the fight and bring more Ariados in for a 3 Star photo. In research Lv. 2 a trio of Ariados will be hanging from a web alongside some Morelull. They can be lured down the the melody where, if you've lured Bounsweet and Leafeon in, it will scare them
Magikarp will be in the lake at the end of the level swimming around underwater
Quagsire appears asleep by the lake. As it's asleep, its interactions are minimal. By the lake, reach, you will see a Quagsire swimming around in the lake
Pikipek appears using a fluffruit into the tree hole to lure it out. Some sleeping Pikipek can also be found on trees, alongside the Toucannon in the big tree above the ruins too

Toucannon appears sleeping in the trees in the early part of the stage. If you keep hitting the Crystabloom after it goes out they will fly away and photograph the response opportunity. In the big tree above the ruins, a few will be sleeping in their nets. If you activate the Crystablooms in the tree, they will awaken. If you awakened them all from the tree and they fly away, they will end up near the course exit flying through

Wooper appears in a couple of areas near the lake near the course exit. First it will be around the water in research Lv. 1 and will interact there. Second, behind the Waterfall you will find one sleeping next to Swampert. Another will come up to try to wake them up

Leafeon appears throughout the stage running. It will lead you into the Swamp Path but you can divert it in utilising a fluffruit. Then, if you scare it by playing Melody to bring down Ariados, it'll jump into the pond and awaken Swampert. If you use an Illumina orb, it will play with Swampert for a 4 Star photo opportunity. Later on in the stage, it'll be by the lake and can be lured to the Crystablooms where it will relax for a nice photo opportunity. It will also be in the path behind the waterfall where it will fall asleep

Swampert can be seen in two places. The first has it sleeping delved into the swamp. This is a complicated procedure to Prompt it away. First, you need to divert Leafeon into the Swamp Path by hitting it with a fluffruit before you enter. Then, it and two Bounsweet will go into the path and stop in front of the tree hole. If you play Melody, it will cause the Ariados to drop down, scaring Leafeon and Bounsweet into the swamp awakening Swampert. Swampert will then jump out and, if hit by an Illumina orb, will start playing with Leafeon Secondly, if you go to the path behind the Waterfall, it will be sleeping alongside various other Pokémon

Sometimes, when you go through the Swamp Path, you will see Slaking walking through. When you approach the Swamp Path, you will find a Morelull to the right. If you throw fluffruit at it, you'll lure Slaking out and it'll take some fruit. Then, later you will be able to lure one down to the lake with fluffruit. You will then get it beating its chest for a top photograph
Metapod appears sleeping attached to trees throughout the stage

In research Lv. 1, you can find an Arbok sleeping on a tree early on in the stage. If you keep throwing fluffruit at it, it will fall off the tree and offer its 4 star photo. It will then appear later in the stage swimming through the river In research Lv. 2, Arbok can be spotted in the meadow to the right as you go past the Swamp Path

While the Ledian are typically sleeping attached to trees, if you activate the Crystablooms near the ruins, a swarm of Illumina enfused Ledian will fly out. The Melody will also cause Ledian to remove itself from trees and wake up, flying around. If you Prompt knocked down to the ruins and activate the Crystabloom, you will then be able to feed a Ledian a fluffruit for a 4 star photo. If you wake all 3 Ledian with Melody and hit them with Illumina orbs on the way into the jungle, they will appear by the Waterfall and will fly in formation for a 4 star photo. You can get a better view behind the waterfall

When you reach the lake at the final part of the stage, if you scan you will see 3 unidentified signatures. If you play the Melody and Scan again, these will fly up to be Vivillon. Two Jungle Pattern and 1 River Pattern

When you reach the lake at the final part of the stage, if you scan you will see 3 unidentified signatures. If you play the Melody and Scan again, these will fly up to be Vivillon. Two Jungle Pattern and 1 River Pattern

Turn around right away and play a song. An orb will appear. Throw a fluffruit and Mew will then appear. It will keep reappearing throughout the stage providing you hit the ball and photograph it. Eventually, Prompt to the ruins and play the Melody and Mew will appear at the ruins. Photograph it and it will then appear right in front of you for a four star picture. In research Lv. 1 it can be spawned by hitting Crystabloom twice. If you lure it to near the Morelull, you can play Melody to Prompt them to release spores in order to Photograph Mew sleeping

Shiftry will appear throughout the stage starting with the first foggy area. In research Lv. 1, one will be sitting on a tree but as you progress through the Levels, they will be more active. In research Lv. 3, the stage starts with one Shiftry right up in front of you before meeting a second and running off. In the Spring area, you will find a Shiftry sleeping on a tree. If you use a fluffruit to knock it off, it will move around. Hit it again with an Illumina orb near the leaves and it will use Gust for a 4 star picture. If you go through the Spring Area and Prompt Shiftry to use Gust, it will then appear in the Sunny Area. If you hit it with an Illumina orb at the start, it will then run through the stage and go towards the Bulbasaur and Lotad. Throw another Illumina orb and it will show its power, causing Lotad and Bulbasaur to celebrate. Photograph for a 3 Star photo

Trevenant are found throughout the Foggy Areas of the stage moving around. They can be interacted with and can be quite playful. One can be lured out of the way with a Melody Box to create an alternate path to Prompt to the Summer or Winter Areas. If you scan the area and the Espurr rather than move it, you can get the Espurr to get on the Trevenant for a 4 star photo opportunity In the Sunny Area, a Trevenant appears sleeping

Lotad can be seen in the Ruins area by the ruins. If you lure Bulbasaur over to it, you will be able to Prompt Bulbasaur riding on Lotad. In the Sunny Area, you will find more Lotad. These Lotad are very friendly and will dance to Melody. If you can lure enough together by first hitting one with the fluffruit and then hitting them all with Illumina orbs, you can have them stack up for a 4 star photo

Kecleon is primarily seen along the foggy areas of the stage, hanging off trees or on cliffs. They are camoflagued so require you to hit them with Illumina orbs in order to be visible. They also react to the Melody for some good 3 star photos. A 4 star photo opportunity is in research Lv. 2 when you see 3 of them together. Make them visible and they will run away Kecleon will also appear at various points in the Ruins Area for similar photo opportunities In the Spring Area, you will be able to find a Kecleon hanging upsidedown. If you hit it with an Illumina orb, it will make for a good 3 star photo In the Autumn Area, you can find Kecleon in the first leaf pile

In the Spring Area, various Deerling will play with Sawsbuck throughout the stage. In the second foggy forest, if you didn't go the Spring route, a Spring Form Deerling will appear. To Prompt it to appear, you need to light up the Crystablooms. Light up the first two and Deerling will follow it, then when you get to an opening with two, light up only the back one. Then you'll come across another Crystabloom. Light it and Espeon will come and Deerling will play. Sawsbuck will then come and offer a 4 star photo opportunity when they reunite. In the Sunny Area, if you went the Spring route, the Deerling will appear throughout, as well as sleeping towards the end. reach, there is also a small clearing with a Crystabloom and multiple Deerling/Sawsbuck. Light the Crystabloom and the rest will appear and if you fed Espeon and gave it an Illumina orb after, all four show up. Play Melody for a 4 Star Photo. If you reunited the Deerling and Sawsbuck, they will come with you into the path

In the second foggy forest, if you didn't go the Spring route, a Spring Form Sawsbuck will run around looking for a Deerling. To Prompt it to appear, you need to light up the Crystablooms. In the Winter Area of the stage, you will find two Bewear in a cave hibernating. If you use the Melody, then they will wake up and leave the cave. Bewear can also be found in the ruins walking around. They will react to Crystablooms and can also be lured over to eat apples from a pile involving Applin and photograph the response opportunity. Groups will also chase you if they are angered by multiple fluffruit for a 4 star shot.

Unfezant can be seen in all of the seasonal areas of the stage. In the Spring stage, a couple will be flying around and a pair will be by the big tree and can be illuminated by the Crystabloom. In the Summer stage, there will be a couple of Unfezant walking around but, towards the end, you will find a female Unfezant sitting on a nest. Throw a fluffruit at it for a 4 star photo In Autumn the Unfezant can be lured into the leaf piles to hunt for food.

Pancham is predominantly found within the Summer stage where it will be seen playfully running about. One will be getting trained by a Shiftry and another pair will be sparring against a bit of bamboo. You can also get Pancham playing by a Crystabloom before going into the river and playing with the water. Another Pancham will be seen playing with Bulbasaur and Drampa across the river Pancham will then be seen in the Ruins alongside Drampa if you had got them interacting in the Summer stage. If you throw an Illumina orb at Drampa in Summer, you can Photograph Drampa flying with Bulbasaur & Pancham in the Sunny Area Iff you went through the Summer Area, Pancham will also appear in the Sunny Area playing with Bulbasaur

Drampa's first appearance can be within the Summer Area of the stage. In the right, just a bit over the river, you can see Drampa playing with Bulbasaur and Pancham. Drampa appears flying around the second foggy stage for some close up shots. Drampa will also be found in the Ruins Area. There will be some Drampa flying around but you will also find one sleeping, sometimes with Bulbasaur and Pancham by it if you went through the Summer stage and photographed it. There, you can anger the Drampa for a 4 star photo. You can also see Drampa flying around the Sunny Area. If you throw an Illumina orb at Drampa in Summer, you can Photograph Drampa flying with Bulbasaur & Pancham in the Sunny Area

Bulbasaur appears in a variety of stages. In the Spring route, it appears behind the tree. If you hit it with an Illumina orb, it will go to a neerby Deerling and Sawsbuck for a talk. In the Summer area, there are more Bulbasaur playing around. One will be seen on top of a waterfall sleeping while you can lure the others onto the waterfall happy. Another Bulbasaur will be playing with a Pancham and a Drampa. In the Ruins Area, a Bulbasaur will be seen by the lake. If you're successful, you can lure it to Lotad in order to ride across the lake for a 4 star photo In the Sunny Area, a Bulbasaur can be seen at the end talking to a Lotad. If you throw an Illumina orb at Drampa in Summer, you can Photograph Drampa flying with Bulbasaur & Pancham in the Sunny Area

Espurr appears throughout the foggy areas of the stage. They will be on trees, staring at you and will sometimes fly down. In the first part, you will see an Espurr behind a rock, throw an Illumina orb at it and it will levitate the rock. Later, there will be three Espurr using their psychic powers to lift up a rock. In the Sunny Area, two Espurr will be asleep curled up next to a Sawsbuck

In the Autumn Area, various Deerling will play with Sawsbuck throughout the stage. Light the Crystabloom and the rest will appear and if you fed Espeon and gave it an Illumina orb after, all four show up. Play Melody for a 4 Star Photo, reach to Prompt all to appear, you need to also feed the Espeon nearby first by awakening it and then feeding it.

Light the Crystabloom and the rest will appear and if you fed Espeon and gave it an Illumina orb after, all four show up. Play Melody for a 4 Star Photo.

Serperior appears in the Autumn part of the stage beyond two rivers. It can be interacted with using fluffruit and Illumina orbs. If you hit it with an Illumina orb and then play Melody, it will use Leaf Storm for a 4 star photo If you went the Autumn Route, Serperior will also appear in the final ruins part of the stage and you will find it sleeping. If you wake it up using a fluffruit then Illumina orb then give it a fluffruit to go to sleep with Melody, you will be able to get a 4 star photo

Applin appears in two areas. First in the Autumn Area, you will find one sleeping by a tree. If you lure a Deerling over to it, then it will fight off the Deerling for a 4 star photo. reach, if you awaken it through other means, it will roll away. In the final ruins part of the stage, there will be two Applin sleeping at the left of the stage but you'll see more Applin hidden amongst berries. If you lure Bewear over, it will run away for a 3 star photo opportunity. If you lure Espeon to the Ruins, you also find Espeon there sleeping with Applin. It will also awaken if you play the Melody. Photograph Applin out the apple by knocking it off trees in the Sunny Area and Autumn area and grabbing it in shot before it re-enters the apple for a 4 star photo.

In the Winter Area, various Deerling will play with Sawsbuck throughout the stage. When you enter the standard final part of the stage, you will see Celebi flying about. If you hit it with a Illumina orb in time, it will time travel away. If you then throw fluffruit at the group of apples underneat the tree, Celebi will appear again and eat a fluffruit. Then, it will appear on the ruins to the left. If you hit the Crystablooms, then look to the left, three more Celebi will fly in for a 4 Star picture
Magikarp is only visible in the standard final stage and only if you through fluffruit in the water

Espeon starts to appear in the stage at research Lv. 3 and can be the control to the various different parts. It will appear in the first Foggy area where it will be at a crossroads. If you ignore it, you will go to Spring. If you hit it with a fluffruit, you will go to Autumn. If you hit it with an Illumina orb you will go to Summer and if you lure Trevenant away to Prompt the alternate route and hit it with an Illumina orb, you will go to Winter. Espeon will then appear in the second foggy forest. If you light up the lone Crystabloom, it will come to it. If you have lured the Deerling there, it will happily wait for the deerling and play before running off towards the Ruins. You will also find Espeon sleeping in the Sunny Area. You can Prompt Espeon in the Ruins area by having it follow the paths you go and luring the Deerling to the Crystabloom in the second Foggy Area. You will then see it sleeping alongside Applin

Gardevoir will appear in the Winter Area of the stage. It will play some Hide-and-Seek with Deerling for some good photo opportunities. If you Illumina orb it, it will Teleport and the Deerling will follow it. Keep doing this until it moves near the Crystabloom. Light up the Crystabloom and it will use a move to create snow on the tree. This is a 4 star opportunity In the Sunny Area, Gardevoir will also randomly appear to the left of the stage when you come in

Ninetales appears in the Winter Area of the stage sitting atop a cliffside. If you hit it with a fluffruit, it will shake its tails at you. If you have lured Deerling over by forcing one movement of Deerling with Gardevoir but not the other, then hit the Deerling with a fluffruit, Ninetales will jump out. Hit it with an orb and a fluffruit and it will unleash some fire which will be a 4 star photo. After that, Ninetales will be seen in the Sunny Area.

Modern Pattern Vivillon is found in the Autumn stage. If you hit Serperior with the Ilulmina Orb and then play Melody, it will go over to deerling and use Leaf Storm and photograph the response. Then, look to the far right and up and you will see Modern Pattern Vivillon

Elegant Pattern Vivillon is found towards the end of the stage after a convoluted set of instructions. First, take the alternate route by the Trevenant and follow Espeon to the next area. When you Prompt to the second foggy area, light up the Crystablooms to lure Deerling to Espeon. When there, Espeon, Deerling and Sawsbuck will have a reunion. Take the path to the Sunny Area. To the left of the Sunny Area you will see Espeon. Knock it down with a scan and feed it, then give it an Illumina orb afterwards. It will then move over to the plains for all seasons. Hit the Crystabloom to attract all the Deerling and Sawsbuck in. Then, as you approach the end of the stage, Vivillon will appear. It's a guaranteed 4 Star Photo

Milotic is the third Illumina Pokémon to encounter. As it's a Water Pokémon and you're not underwater, using your Illumina orbs tends not to work so you need to hit it with fluffruit in order for it to surface so you can hit it with Illumina orbs On subsequent visits, various Pokémon will inhabit the area, interacting with Milotic. Milotic will also do various attacks such as Twister for favourable photo opportunities.
Magikarp appears in much of the early stage underwater. If Milotic swims by them, or activates its Illumina stage by them, they will shoot up out of the water
Lotad is found throughout the stage, either in water or on small islands. Milotic will often swim past them when in Illumina phase and activate theirs, making the mmove faster and be happier
Bulbasaur appears on an island

Ninetales will come up to the Crystablooms on the island with Trevenant when Milotic has jumped on the island to smell the flower. It will stand around and smell the flower then return to the other side of the island to rest
Serperior appears on a small island. If Milotic is out of the water by then, it'll come up to Serperior and say hello, creating a decent 3 star photo opportunity
Trevenant can be seen sleeping across the islands of this area. They will awaken with Illumina Energy

Espeon appears on one of the last islands sleeping. It can be awakened with Illumina Energy. If you awaken it before Milotic stops interacting with Serperior, it will come over to say hello to Espeon. Take a photo for a 4 star photo
Early in the stage, Kecleon appears hidden on one of the islands. It requires Illumina orbs to be thrown at it to appear

Magikarp appears throughout the stage including at the start. They will be swimming aroud going down the river and can be utilised for photos in these areas. In other parts of the stage, one will sometimes pop out of the water when you throw a fluffruit. There will be a few by the waterfall at the middle part of the stage which will start splashing up if you activate the Crystabloom by the waterfall. In research Lv. 3, you will find one swimming under an Ursaring that is sleeping. If you use scan, it will jump up and knock the Ursaring off and photograph the response. In research Lv. 2, if you rescue the Psyduck from the Aipom, you can release a Magikarp from the water using an Illumina orb just before the first waterfall, this will lead Psyduck to it and use Psychic on the Magikarp for a 4 star photo.
Beautifly will be seen flying around the early and final parts of the stage,. In the final part, you can use Melody to Prompt the Beautifly to dance and photograph the response

Grookey appears running around the stage off to the sides throughout the entire stage. it will often be playing with Sobble and will run around and sometimes pose. near the course exit, it will be curled up asleep with Tropius and photograph the response opportunity

Sobble appears running around the stage off to the sides throughout the entire stage. it will often be playing with Grookey and will run around and sometimes pose. near the course exit, it will be curled up asleep with Tropius and photograph the response opportunity

Aipom appears throughout the stage. There will be a few swinging between the river aat the start and jumping on trees. In research Lv. 1 and 2, a trio of Aipom will be harassing a Psyduck. if you took Magikarp out of the water, you can knock it out of the tree onto Psyduck's head and photograph the response If you the fluffruit at the Aipom at the start, you will be able to see them at the ceiling inside the cave. If you throw fluffruit at the Aipom at the start of the level, they will follow the Grookey and Sobble through the level at various points and end up sleeping alongside them in the final area

Tropius appears throughout the stage sleeping or moving around the stage. In research Lv. 3, if you throw an Illumina orb at the bubbles early on, you will Prompt a Wooper to come out and talk to the Tropius for a shot. Then, as you go down the stage, the Tropius will fly over with Wooper on its head. This is a 4 star photo. If you Photograph Tropius flying, it is a 3 star photo. Tropius can also be found sleeping near the course exit with Grookey and Sobble, and sometimes Aipom

Psyduck appears in numerous places. In research Lv. 1 & 2, Psyduck will be at the start being attacked by some Aipom. Rescue it and you can then lkure a Magikarp over to Prompt Psyduck to use Psychic on it for a 4 star photo. Later, you will be able to Prompt one to jump out of the water using Illumina orbs at the water for a 3 star photo. If you go through the cave, Psyduck will float down the rapids alongside you. If you awoke Arbok, a Psyduck will also be asleep next to the Arbok for a 3 star photo As you go down, you will also see a Psyduck with a Wooper. If you offer them fluffruit, Psyduck will give the fluffruit to Wooper and photograph the response

Toucannon can be seen flying or perched throughout the stage,. When landed, they can be fed fluffruit for a 3 star shot. As you go down the rapids, a trio of Toucannon will land and squark at you and photograph the response. You can hit the Crystabloom for another photo opportunity.
A Feraligatr can be seen near the course entrance. It will pop out and roar for a 3 star photo. Later on in the Cave there is a

Swampert can be seen swimming around the river throughout the stage. If you hit each one with an Illumina orb, then hit the bubbles near the course exit, the three will appear at the end and jump out of the water for a 4 Star Photo
Activate both Crystabloom in the stage and look behind you at the end and Vivillon will fly out. Two Jungle Vivillon can also be seen around the Crystabloom

Arbok first appears swimming near the course entrance. If you hit the area with an Illumina orb, it will come out of the water partially, but if you then use scan, it will come out entirely, which also awakens some Drilbur. In research Lv. 3, if you do this, it will then appear and face off against the Ursaring. If you Illumina orb it, it will attack the Ursaring for a 4 star photo. Then, if all that is done, it will appear near the course exit sleeping alongside Psyduck

Wooper appears in a number of places. First one will be seen on the island near the course entrance. Then, some will be following Quagsire as it swims. One will also be on the sideof the stage by Psyduck and will eat a fluffruit if it is given to Psyduck.

Quagsire appears in a couple of parts of the stage. Most notably, if you look behind you after going down various rapids, it will happily be going down them. You will also see it swimming with 2 Wooper following it
Metapod appears on trees near the start of the satage and in the field. If you lure Arbok onto the ground with scan, they will use harden for a 4 star photo opportunity

Ursaring appears in a variety of places on the stage. First an Ursaring will come up to the Psyduck to scare it. If you have Psyduck hit with an Illumina orb, Psyduck will attack causing Ursaring to roar for a 3 star photo. Alternatively, if you awoke Arbok, Arbok will appear and they will fight. If you use an Illumina orb on Ursaring, it will attack Arbok for a 4 star photo Next, one is sleeping on a log over the water by the waterfall. If you use scan while the Magikarp is underneath it, it will get hit in the fact by the Magikarp for a 3 star photo. If you do this, it will be found holding onto a tree sleeping near the course exit.
Venusaur appears sleeping in the plains by the Waterfall during Research research Lv. 3. If you successfully got Tropius to land in the area, the Venusaur will wake up and move about

Drilbur appears in the rockfaces to the left digging during Research research Lv. 3. if you Prompt them digging, you will get a 3 Star photo. However, if you get them to dig, they will then propel themselves across the river for a 4 star photo in research Lv. 3, you can Prompt some Drilbur near the course entrance by knocking Arbok off the land. They will be startled but present the 3 star photos In the rapids, use the Crystabloom to summon the Toucannon and then play Melody. Two Drilbur will jump up for a midair pose for a 4 star photo
River Pattern Vivillon can be seen up on the cliffside by the waterfalls sitting on the wall. Another will fly out near the course exit if you activated all the Crystalbloom

Cleffa appears within the Moonlit Cave path of the stage. First, a Cleffa appears on the ledge to the right, but will react when you scan and move away. Then, in the main chamber of the cave, if you use an Illumina orb on the Crystabloom multiple times, four Cleffa will come out and will use Metronome for a 3 Star Photo, that turns into a tornado for a four star photo

To Prompt Gyarados, you need to Illumina orb the two Magikarp on the way through the course, then activate the Crystabloom that is hidden behind the waterfall. Then, as you reach the end of the level, Gyarados will jump down the rapids and be interactable. To Prompt its 3 star interaction, hit it with an Illumina orb. to get its 4 star interaction, get a pciture of it in the air as it is jumping down the rapids

In research Lv. 1, Jungle Pattern Vivillon can be seen right at the start flying ahead of you. It will then appear again near the course exit alongside a River Pattern Vivillon Another appears in research Lv. 2. If you Illumina orb two Ledian that are hiding in shrubbery, they will fly into the valley to the right and activate three Vivillon

Morelull appears throughout the stage at the sides and can be lit up if hit with an Illumina orb. Midway through the stage, a group will be by some sleeping Tropius and can be activated for a 3 Star photo. Another group appears within the Moonlit Cave

Tropius can mostly be found sleeping near the course exit, and one appears drinking from the water near the course entrance in research Lv. 2. If you Prompt the Tropius to take off, you have a 3 Star photo. This is done with Illumina orb and Melody. In research Lv. 1, a trio appears sleeping on the plains by the waterfall. In research Lv. 2, one appears sleeping by the Crystabloom on the cliff by the first waterfall and another with Swampert to the left. If you manage to activate the Crystabloom, the Tropius will wake up and fly over the plains next to the waterfall. Then, several Tropius will fly through the rest of the stage

In research Lv. 1, Psyduck appears swimming just past the first island. If you hit the Wooper in the head with a fluffruit in the main water area, it will jump and Prompt Psyduck to swim with it and appear either in the cave or alongside the Quagsire and Wooper by the Crystabloom in the rapids

Beautifly appears during a variety of parts of the stage, either flying around or sticking to the wall. They can be moved by Illumina orbs and may dance and photograph the response opportunity. A collection of them will fly away near the course exit

Ariados appears in a number of areas of the stage. First one appears directly right and will chase a Drilbur. In research Lv. 2, one appears on the cobweb above and can be hit by an Illumina orb and photograph the response. Finally, a pair will be on the small area just before the waterfall, with one hanging down from a tree. You can get close photos by angering Feraligatr

near the course entrance, two Wooper can be seen happily running around the left, offering a good photo opportunity. A pair of Wooper will also be in the area to the left with Quagsire. If you get them chatting, it is a 3 Star Photo. In research Lv. 1, a Quagsire appears on the rapids. If you hit an Illumina orb, a Wooper will jump out and play with it and photograph the response. In research Lv. 2, a pair appears behind the sleeping Quagsire in the plains. In the bit by the rapids, there will be a Wooper and Quagsire sitting on the cliff. if you hit them with an Illumina orb, you will get a 3 star photo In research Lv. 1, a Wooper appears in the Moonlit Cave if you activate both Crystabloom.

Quagsire appears in a number of areas of the stage. First, one will be with two Wooper at the field just before the waterfall. After that, a sleeping Quagsire appears on the plains by the giant waterfall. If you awakened the Tropius by the waterfall, then Psyduck will push the Quagsire into the water. if you play Melody, they will head into the Alternate Path and appear in the cave when you use scan In research Lv. 1, a Quagsire appears on the rapids. If you hit an Illumina orb, a Wooper will jump out and play with it and photograph the response. In the standard path, you will see some bubbling water. If you use scan, you will get a Quagsire peer out of the way

Swampert can be seen in a couple of parts of the stage partially submerged underwater. Using the Illumina orb will bring them out from the depths. One will then be found sleeping near the course exit. In research Lv. 2, you will find a Swampert sleeping inside the Moonlit Cave. You will also find one to the left of the first waterfall down sleeping. If you Illumina orb both Crystabloom, you will wake iup

Feraligatr can be seen in a few areas of the stage. A couple will be swimming underwater. In research Lv. 1, you will find one sleeping on top of a log just in front of the Waterfall. In research Lv. 2, as you go past the island, you will see two water bubbles. Hit them with Illumina orbs and two Feraligatr will jump out and fight for a 3 star photo. Another will be on top of a cliff. Hit it with two fluffruit and it will later jump down and knock you off course, also offering a 4 star photo opportunity. Another will be under the rocks on the path down. Finally, a Feraligatr will be swimming in the final area

Toucannon will be flying through various parts of the stage, often stopping on perches for photo opportunities. lure the Toucannon to the part opposite the cliffside by knocking away the Beautifly and playing Melody near the course entrance by the island. They will land. Play Melody and hit them with an Illumina orb for a 4 star photo

In research Lv. 1, you can find the River Pattern Vivillon at the very end of the stage alongside a Jungle Pattern vivillon. However, once you Prompt access to the Moonlit Cave, you will find 5 different River Pattern Vivillon stuck to the walls. In the main part of the cave, when you activate the Crystabloom, they will detach and start dancing. Another appears in research Lv. 2. If you Illumina orb two Ledian that are hiding in shrubbery, they will fly into the valley to the right and activate three Vivillon. If you knock all the Beautifly off the walls and vines, one will also appear in the rapids

Ledian can be seen flying around the stage at various parts. There are two that are hidden behind leaves next to the cave entrance in research Lv. 2 that can be activated with Illumina orbs. Later, as you go down the rapids, you will find another 2 Ledian land next to a Crystabloom. Hit the Crystabloom and both Ledian will start dancing

Aipom appears early in the stage hanging from cvarious tree branches. In research Lv. 2, one will be sleeping on top of the log in front of a waterfall. If you anger the Aipom near the course entrance, you will see a couple running through the stage. Some will be sleeping curled up next to Tropius near the course exit as well When the Aipom calls its friends to look down at you mid-course, play melody. It will be happy and follow you down. Photograph it happily celebrating

Ursaring appears in multiple places of the stage. First, one can be seen in the main outlet just before the first waterfall sleeping. If you are kncoked over there by Feraligatr, it will wake up and shout at the Feraligatr and photograph the response opportunity. Alternatively, if you Illumina orb the Aipom near the course entrance, they will come to the Ursaring and wake it up, causing Ursaring to angrily slash the tree for a 4 star photo. After that, one can be seen in the valley just after the main waterfall. If you activate the Ledian with Illumina orbs, they will fly and Prompt some Vivillon which will cause ursaring to come all the way down the stage, scaring the Psyduck. After that, an Ursaring appears in the middle of the rapids looking at some Magikarp. If you hit the Crystabloom and use Scan on the Magikarp, the Magikarp will jump up and hit Ursaring in the face for a 4 star photo

Drilbur appears in a number of sections of the stage. First one appears to the right of you at the very start. It will be startled by an Ariados and will run away before digging down, allowing for you to Prompt a good shot. Another is found on the small island just beyond there where it will also dig down if Melody is played or jump out spinning for a 4 star photo. Another appears in the area just before the waterfall. If you throw multiple fluffruit into the bushes, it will come out of the bushes and you can startle it for it to dig down for a close up 3 star photo. After that, one appears behind the Ursaring on the side of the mountain as you're going down the rapids. Another pair of Drilbur appears in the Moonlit Cave if you hit both Crystabloom, they will jump out and then start digging. Another is found in the plains by the waterfall if you hit the sleeping Quagsire with a fluffruit and Illunmina Orb the 2 Wooper. if you then use Scan, it will wave to the Wooper for a 3 star photo. Finally, if that is done, they will appear on the final island

Magikarp appears swimming around the start of the stage. Ithrow 2 Illumina orb the two Magikarp beyond the first rapids and hit Feraligatr with fluffruit to knock you off course. They will move to the waterfall. Then, use an Illumina orb on the Crystabloom and the Magikarp will start splashing. Eventually, a Gyarados will jump out of the water and start swimming up the waterfall and 5 Magikarp will swim up there in formation. In research Lv. 2, you can Prompt Magikarp to flop up to hit the sleeping Ursaring using Scan for a 3 Star photo and, later on, you can hit the Crystabloom as you go down the rapids and the nuse Scan to Prompt Magikarp to slap the Ursaring on the nose for a 4 star photo

Cleffa appears in two places. In research Lv. 2, a Cleffa will follow a group of Wooper and will be eligible for a 3 Star photo in doing so. After that, you can find Cleffa within the Moonlit Cave. Two Cleffa will be sleeping but can be awakened by activating the Crystabloom where they'll start to walk around. If you play Melody, they will start to dance for a 4 star photo

To Prompt the Monsoon Pattern Vivillon to appear, you need to hit two Crystablooms inside the Moonlit Cave. When the second Crystabloom is hit, the Monsoon Vivillon will fly in behind you Another appears in research Lv. 2. If you Illumina orb two Ledian that are hiding in shrubbery, they will fly into the valley to the right and activate three Vivillon

To awaken Gyarados, there are to means. First, light up all two Crystablooms on the way down the waterfall with Illumina orbs. Then, wait until Magikarp is underneath Ursaring and use scan. Then light up the Crystabloom behind the Waterfall and Gyarados will briefly appear. For the other method, you need to wake up then throw 2 Illumina orb the two Magikarp beyond the first rapids and hit Feraligatr with fluffruit to knock you off course. They will move to the waterfall. Then, use an Illumina orb on the Crystabloom and the Magikarp will start splashing. Eventually, a Gyarados will jump out of the water and start swimming up the waterfall

Crabrawler appears on the beach near the course entrance as well as at the end of it. Here, it will be seen just stretching its legs and moving about. At research Lv. 3, you can find two Crabrawler sparring for a top quality picture

Exeggutor appears in multiple parts of the early part of the stage. There are a couple moving around near the course entrance and one sleeping in the middle. On the path, there is also an Exeggutor blocking the way. At the end opf the beach, you will find another sleeping Exeggutor

Wingull appears in various parts of the stage. At the start, many will be flying over the beach and the water. If you play the melody, you will Prompt them to do loop-the-loops. Near the Secret Beach, you will also see three Wingull divebomb into the water
Bellossom appears towards the end of the first part of the beach. It can be lured out with the Crystablooms and will react to the Scan and the Melody with a dance

Pikachu can be seen at the front of the beach frolicking, using its electricity and more. At the end of the beach, you'll find another Pikachu. This Pikachu will be able to watch Alolan Raichu's surfing, or will be led onto a Stunfisk for some surfing of its own

Octillery appears in the Secret Beach part of the stage. First one will be found on the actual beach alongside Machamp but from research Lv. 2 and 3, you will find one in the water nearby next to something hidden. If you play the melody, it will pop out and be a Stunfisk
Marine Pattern Vivillon appears as you approach the path to the Secret Beach
As you approach the Secret Beach, you will see a school of Finneon in the water.As you continue on the standard path, there will also be another school in front of the Crystablooms island
Pyukumuku appears in various rocks when you're in the water part. You can get good pictures from it by playing Melody or giving it fluffruit. It will often wave when you use a scan or Melody

Machamp appears in two places. First it appears on the Secret Beach alongside Stunfisk and Octillery where it is training. On the usual path at research Lv. 3, you will also see Machamp standing on a rock flexing its muscles staring out to sea. Throw an Illumina orb for a top picture. If you throw a fluffruit in front of it, it will dive into the water and swim around to the final beach by Blastoise

Stunfisk appears on various parts of the beach towards the end. It flops around the stage but can have a Pikachu lured to it where Pikachu will treat it like a surfboard for a classic picture. In the Secret Beach part of the stage, you can also lure Stunfisk out of the sand by using Scan. If you hit it with a fluffruit, it will use its electricity against Octillery for a 3 star photo
Corsola appears on the beach next to a Crystablooms dancing. If you use the Crystablooms, then it will start to absorb sunlight for a top picture. Another can be seen next to a Pyukumuku
After research Lv. 2, Alolan Raichu can be seen practicing its surfing along the sand dunes towards the end. Pikachu can be lured to watch, reach the Raichu will sometimes fail at its jumps
Lapras will come in to the stage after research Lv. 2. One will start swimming around the opening beach. At the end of the level, you will see another Lapras come through with a Squirtle on its back
At the end of the level, you will see another Lapras come through with a Squirtle on its back

When you reach research Lv. 3, you will find a Blastoise on the beach lying on its back. Hit it with enough fluffruit and it will wake up. If you use the Melody or Illumina orb, it will use its Hydro Pump

Three Exeggutor can be spotted sleeping on the early part of the beach. If you lure a Crabrawler to one with some fluffruit, it will move up to the Exeggutor and pinch it, waking it up. The Exeggutor will be angry and make chase, getting any further Crabrawler in its path. Later at the end of the beach if you do this, they will run out out the bushes and continue being chased. This is a 4 star interaction for the chase and 3 star for being pinched
A swarm of Vivillon can be spotted near the course entrance flying through. Another batch appears in the standard path as you make the corner towards Octillery

In the first beach, you can see a Zangoose sitting. If you take the Primarina out with an Illumina orb, you can lure it to the flowers before the cave where it will practice its move. reach, throw in a fluffruit, Seviper will come out and the two will fight. A second Zangoose appears sitting and watching Primarina's concert
Drifblim can be seen near the course entrance in research Lv. 1 floating through. near the course exit, you can also see a group of Drifblim out in the distance carrying Clamperl

Seviper can first be seen in the flowers of the first beach. It can be lured out with a fluffruit. reach, if you have brought Zangoose to the area, then the two will fight for a 4 Star picture opportunity for both. Later on, another Seviper will approach Octiller on the island with the Crystablooms. If you activate the Crystablooms, it will be scared off and will swim away for another good photo opportunity
Inkay can be seen in the waters near the course entrance and as you continue the standard path
Two Pyukumuku will be fighting with a third watching on a rock in the standard path. If you throw Illumina orbs at them, the fight will be over and they will celebrate
You can find Magikarp beached on a rock on the standard path in research Lv. 1. In research Lv. 2, you can see it jumping up in the cave area in the small gap where Vivillon is

Octillery appears in two areas of this stage. In the first, in the usual path it appears near the Crystablooms on an island. In research Lv. 1, if you hit the Crystablooms, Octillery will spit some ink upwards. In research Lv. 2, a Seviper will swim up to it and start challenging it. If you do nothing, Seviper will take Octillery out. If you hit the Crystablooms, then Octillery will fight off the Seviper and Seviper will swim away.
