You can then use scan to make Octillery scratch its head. Another Octillery appears on the last beach by a Sandygast. If you awaken the Sandygast with a fluffruit, the Octillery will run away in fear with a comical photo opportunity
In research Lv. 1, a colony of Clamperl can be spotted on a rock. In research Lv. 2, a Clamperl can be seen sitting on a rock by Octillery while the others are being carried away by Drifbli
A Mareanie appears cuddled up with a Corsola on the Secret Beach. They are inseparable and will follow fluffruit together and watch Primarina's concert
A Mareanie appears cuddled up with a Corsola on the Secret Beach. They are inseparable and will follow fluffruit together and watch Primarina's concert
A group of Bellossom appears on the Secret Beach. They will activate to music and will dance to Primarina's concert

Sandygast appears on the final part of the beach. There are two, both deflated. One can be opened using a fluffruit, which startles the Octillery who runs away in fear. If you Photograph it using Hypnosis you Prompt a 3 star photo. If you lure Crabrawler over to it and have Crabrawler make it bigger, you have a 4 star photo

In research Lv. 1, Alolan Raichu appears surfing in the final part of the beach. In research Lv. 2, you can find Alolan Raichu sleeping on top of a rock on the standard path. If you throw multiple fluffruit at the sleeping Raichu. Eventually it'll start to glow Blue. Hit it again and it'll flip over

Finneon appears in the final part of the stage. If you play the melody, Finneon will surface and can be hit by Illumina orbs. If it does, then it will chase its tail. If you play the Melody, one will jump high in the air and will be a 4 Star photo opportunity

Wingull appears in one area of Beach (Night). It appears sleeping on the northern path to the left of the island with Octillery and Seviper. It can be awoken using the fluffruit and will even eat it for a 3 star photo

Primarina can be seen far out in the ocean. If you hit it with an Illumina orb, then it will swim off. Next, you will find it in the Secret Beach performing a concert for the local Pokémon, which is a good photo opportunity. If you hit the Crystablooms by it, its song changes

Crabrawler appears in the early part of the beach. It will be practicing its moves but, in research Lv. 2, a pair of Pikachu will come up to it and it will try to start a fight. It will splash and eventually win. In the final beach, another Crabrawler can be seen, also practicing its moves. near the course entrance, If you lure a Crabrawler to one with some fluffruit, it will move up to the Exeggutor and pinch it, waking it up. The Exeggutor will be angry and make chase, getting any further Crabrawler in its path. Later at the end of the beach if you do this, they will run out out the bushes and continue being chased. This is a 4 star interaction for the chase. If you Prompt it to fight with Sandygast by luring it over, you will also get a 4 star photo

A pair of Pikachu appears in the beaches. They will pair up together and photograph the responsegraph and will event fight a Crabrawler. If you hit the Crabrawler during their fight, they will be found staring at the horizon in the final part of the beach

A few schools of Finneon appears towards the start of the stage. There isn't much interaction, but the is a special interaction if you throw a fluffruit into a school of Finneon. A Finneon will jump out and Wingull will swoop in and grab the Finneon, flying off with it

Sharpedo appears as a menace to various Pokémon inside this stage, as well as chasing eachother, there will be instances of it chasing a Squirtle, chasing it up to a pillar in research Lv. 2 or a Lapras that will defend it in research Lv. 3. A later one will also be near a Machamp and will eventually challenge it to a race

Many Wingull adorn this stage. You'll find some flying generally, others will be sitting on top of pillars. One has a special interaction if you throw a fluffruit into a school of Finneon. A Finneon will jump out and Wingull will swoop in and grab the Finneon, flying off with it

Pelipper appears towards the end of the stage. They gather in the Blue Hole special area and can bob for fluffruit and Pyukumuku. If you hit them with a fluffruit, then they will through the Pyukumuku out of their mouths or if you hit with an Illumina orb, then they will post with the Pyukumuku for a 4 star photo
Magikarp is spotted using fluffruit into the whirlpool

Machamp can be seen practicing on a pillar. reach, you have the ability through photographing it of getting it to enter a race against a Sharpedo. This will resulti in a good photo opportunity for both Pokémon
Mareanie appears near the course exit chasing a Corsola by a Crystablooms. It can be stopped using a Scan

Corsola appears in the final area of the stage on some reef. A few Corsola will be on their own happy and dancing but one will be attacked by a Mareanie. If you use the Crystablooms, another will jump in to the pool with the Mareanie

Some Mantine appears swimming through the stage. They will often jump out of the water and if you're playing music, will do a loop. In research Lv. 3, a group of three Mantine will be sat in the water in a triangle and can react to Illumina orbs and music. If you light the first Crystabloom up in the stage, a Mantine will come through the stage carrying a Pikachu

Wailord will come up and breach the water. It'll be able to open its mouth when you throw an Illumina orb at it, which allows you to then throw a fluffruit in its mouth for a smiling picture or, if you go from behind, you'll be able to Prompt it to spin for a 4 star picture

Pyukumuku appears in a variety of areas. You will find a couple sitting on the reef towards the end. If you go to the Secret Cove area, a number will be within the mouths of Pelipper. If you throw fluffruit or Illumina orbs at Pelipper, you'll be able to Prompt it spat out or get it to do a pose, both for a 4 star photo

In research Lv. 2 onwards, as you near the start of the stage, if you hit the first Crystabloom with an Illumina orb, you will sometimes get a special shot of a Mantine riding into the stage with a Pikachu riding on it

Squirtle will appear in research Lv. 2. A group will be sitting on an island sleeping while another can be knocked into the whirlpool. A special interaction is seeing one chased by a Sharpedo until it hits a pillar in research Lv. 2 or a Lapras in research Lv. 3
Lapras appears in research Lv. 3. It will be found coming to the rescue of Squirtle from the Sharpedo and will angrily send it away.
Wailmer appears when you almost reach the alternate path and look back. It will have surfaced looking back. You can Prompt it to release water from its body using an Illumina orb at it

A squad of Inkay appears right near the start of the level. They will sometimes bob out of the water allowing for Illumina orbs and can be activated with the nearby Crystablooms which makes them jump out of the water. If you hit the other Crystablooms by the water, the Wailord will go under and the two Inkay can be seen playing with Manaphy

Two Wailord will still sit in the water. They can be hit with Illumina orbs to et them to spray water out of their blowholes for a 4 star interactions. If you hit both Crystabloomss, the righthand Wailord will go underwater, giving you an additional path

A Squirtle can be seen on top of a pillar blowing out some bubbles. If you knock it down with a fluffruit, a Wingull will push it into the Whirlpool. Take a picture for a 4 star photo. If you use Illumina orb to summon Blastoise after this, Squirtle will be rescued. Photograph Squirtle on Blastoise's back for a 4 star photo. If you don't summon Blastoise, you will find the Squirtle in the distance in the Lapras area

Alolan Raichu appears in this stage surfing. This is the same Alolan Raichu from the Beach that was practicing its moves. If you photograph it, it will surf up close to the Wailord and then do a jump. Photograph the jump for a special interaction and a 4 star photo
Wingull appears around the stage flying high or sitting on the pillars
Mareanie appears towards the end of the stage with the Clamperl. If you can lure it over to the Clamperl using fluffruit at the Drifblim, it will attack the Clamperl for a 4 star photo

A group of Drfiblim will be seen going through the level, with some carrying Clamperl. This is to take them right to the end to put them into safety. After the Wailord there's a Drifblim you can overinflate for a 4 star photo

A school of Mantine will swim through the stage, doing loop jumps. If you turbo ahead and then use scan, the Mantine will do a special rolling jump behind you. Photograph the higher jumping Mantine for a 4 star photo

Primarina appears on a pillar blowing bubbles half way through the stage. Once startled, it'll go to swim off but can be made to dance in the water while doing so by hitting an Illumina orb, causing it to jump in the air for a 4 star photo

In the blue hole, a group of four Lapras appears relaxing. They can start singing when you throw Illumina orbs at them, with two sitting in the middle. This can create an interaction to summon the Mythical Pokémon Manaphy
Clamperl appears either being carried through the stage by Drifblim or at the final part of the reef sitting next to the water or in the water.

Vaporeon can be seen near the course entrance swimming away. If you hit it with an Illumina orb, it will swim faster and eventually stop on a reef where it can be given some fluffruit. Later on in the stage, you'll be able to scan to find a Blue Hole. If you play Melody with it and hit Crystablooms earlier, a Vaporeon will jump out, offering a 4 star photo. It will then follow you and arrive right near the course exit

Some Ocean Pattern Vivillon can be spotted in the distance within the stage. If you speed through the stage you'll be able to Prompt closer. There is also a special interaction if you illuminate the Crystablooms by the Inkay and then the second one. A Vivillon will fly to the Manaphy and give a close up image

Blastoise appears in the whirlpool. If you throw lots of Illumina orbs at it, Blastoise will spin out of it before rocketing away to the end of the stage. This is a 4 Star interaction. near the course exit, you will find Blastoise hiding in its shell

The first appearance of Manaphy you will see requires a lot of intricate work. First, you need to lure the Inkay over to the first Crystablooms and have them jump. If you then hit the second Crystablooms, Wailord will go under water and Manaphy will swim in and play with the Inkay, giving a 3 Star photo shot. It also starts dancing if you play Melody There is a second appearance if you go to the Blue Spot towards the end which takes you to a small area which has four Lapras. If you hit all four with Illumina orbs and play the melody, Manaphy will appear, jumping between two Lapras. You can get its 4 Star by then throwing an Illumina orb at it.

Magikarp appears all over the undersea stage. In the start of the stage it appears and in the standard path, it'll be found in various parts. The most prominent bit is in the final area in research Lv. 3 where many Magikarp start getting dragged down to the depths by Frillish
Finneon appears in schools towards the start of the stage.

Luvdisc appears in schools near the course entrance. Nearer the alternate path, you'll be able to find a pair sleeping in Corsola's corals and you'll be able to find a group kissing when you set of a Crystablooms and if you play Melody, you Prompt them to flip over to look like a clover for a 4 star shot

Corsola appears near the course entrance by a Crystablooms. If you activate the Crystablooms, it will start dancing and attract lots of Pokémon around. In research Lv. 3, another appears on the other side of the reef asleep with two Luvdisc in its sticks.

Lumineon appears in numerous parts of the stage. In the standard path, it will be amongst the seaweed, with one sleeping on top of a Crystablooms. In the Undersea Cave part, in addition to fleeing Wailord, it can also be found on the seafloor where it can be used to be lured to Clamperl or Starmie

Octillery appears next to Wailmer in the usual path. It will start to challenge the Wailmer before being blown down. If you take the Undersea Cave path, as you start to submerge you will see the Octillery fall down and land on a cliffface

Wailmer appears in multiple parts of the stage. On the standard path, you'll find a Wailmer near a Pyukumuku in research Lv. 2 or an Octillery in research Lv. 1 where it will blow them away. It will also be in the Undersea Cave path in research Lv. 2 and 3
Sharpedo can be seen in various submerged elements of the stage, often chasing smaller Pokémon

Qwilfish appears in the cave half way through the standard path of the stage. It will puff up when near a threat, and there's even a photo instance of three teaming up against a Luvdisc. If you Prompt the Clawitzer to attack it and then throw an Illumina orb, it will shoot pins out as an animation
Tentacruel appears in the main path of the stage, dancing in a cave. It can also be found in the Undersea Cave path fighting with a Starmie in research Lv. 3
Mantine can be spotted often swimming above the stage. Another pair appears on the Undersea Cave path swimming down in the depths
Pelipper can be spotted on the surface of the water, sometimes bobbing down

From Research research Lv. 2, Cradily will be found in the seaweed with their heads extended upwards. They can be knocked out of this with fluffruits. They will also dance with the music. If you can lure them to the open, they will dance with necks extended for 4 stars. If you hit them with fluffruit in the Undersea ruins, they will make an attack and extend their frills
Pyukumuku appears in place of the Octillery during Research research Lv. 2 where it will be blown away by the Wailmer

Clawitzer has got multiple different appearances in the stage. In Research research Lv. 2, it appears early in, scaring all the schools of Pokémon near the course entrance before heading to a rock for the alternate path. Hit it with an Illumina orb and it'll break the rocks to open the path. Later on there will be Clawitzer in the main cave of the stage. In research Lv. 2, two Clawitzer will be found firing their cannons at eachother. In research Lv. 3, you'll be able to use the Illumina orb to Prompt Clawitzer to speed through the stage to the cave. When there, it'll face off against the Qwilfish. If you throw an Illumina orb at it, it will fire and knock the Qwilfish back. Do this four times to free the Luvdisc. Attacking the Weilfish is a 3 Star encounter and victory is a 4 star one
Chinchou appears in the Undersea Cave path sitting in a few alcoves
Frillish appears in two areas from research Lv. 2. First towards the end of the standard path, a group will congregate and take Pokémon down with them such as Magikarp.

Lanturn appears in two places. First they'll be in the distance in the Undersea Cave. reach, in research Lv. 3 you'll see one as you start to submerge to the depths. If you Illumina orb it, it'll swim down further until it gets trapped by two Frillish. Free it and it'll go down again and lead you to Lugia's Den. In this path, Lanturn will be asleep on the floor
Clamperl appears partially underground in the Undersea Cave. It can be released by luring Lumineon over to it where it'll pull it up. It'll then be seen swimming afterwards

Golisopod appears in the ancient ruins in the Undersea Cave. They will be slow moving but will react to eachother. If you activate Lugia's roar, you will see Golisopod react to it. If you feed it a fluffruit and Prompt it scratching its whiskers, yuou can get a 3 Star photo. Lure the final one to a rock pillar using fluffruit and watch as it slices the rock for a 4 star photo
Alomomola starts to appear in research Lv. 3 and appears in the start withthe other Pokémon. There are also multiple seen throughout the standard path including some sleeping ones

Inkay appears in the Undersea Cave part of the stage. A squad will swim down the main area as you approach but, when you Prompt to the undersea part, they will start putting all the Chinchou to sleep, perfect for a 3 star photo oopportunity

Starmie is found in the Undersea Cave having a battle with Tentacruel. As you go through the Underground Cave, hit the Inkay with an Illumina orb to Prompt it to zoom off. It will use Hypnosis on Tentacruel and stop the fight with Starmie. Use Scan and it will cause Starmie to use a new attack for a 4 Star photo. After Tentacruel attacks, it swims away. Another can be uncovered by Lumineon on the ground. If one or more are, then they will end up near the Crystabloom later in the stage. If you light the Crystabloom with them in front, then you will get a 4 star photo

In research Lv. 3, Wailord appears as you go into the depths. Once you enter the cave, scores of Pokémon start rapidly swimming upwards and Wailord quickly follows. If you throw an Illumina orb at it, it will open its mouth
Squirtle appears within the seaweed when you reach research Lv. 3
Lapras can be seen swimming overhead towards the end of the stage

You need to use an Illumina orb on a Lanturn when going down the underwater element. Then, free it from two Frillish and it'll take you down a path where Lugia is asleep. You can awaken it by activating both Crystablooms above and next to it. Afterwards, it will be swimming around near the course exit but, if you hit a Crystablooms, it will spin giving a 3 Star photo opportunity and, if you hit it with a fluffruit and then an Illumina orb when it's over the pedestal, that's a 4 star opportunity and it will swim away
Wishiwashi will as standard congregate with other Wishiwashi in its Solo Form. If you use Illumina orbs on many, it'll swim away to become School Form
Wailmer appears in various parts of the stage being chased by Wishiwashi or chasing away Solo Form

Finneon can routinely be found in the groups of Wishiwashi Solo Form. It will swim away when the Wishiwashi get Illumina orbs thrown at them. If you get swallowed by Wishiwashi, when you peer out between its teeth you can see Luvdisc and Finneon. If you use Illumina orbs they will be a 3 star photo

Lumineon can routinely be found in the groups of Wishiwashi Solo Form. It will swim away when the Wishiwashi get Illumina orbs thrown at them. If you get swallowed by Wishiwashi, when you peer out between its teeth you can see Luvdisc and Finneon. If you use Illumina orbs they will be a 3 star photo

Wailord appears towards the end of the stage. If you Prompt enough Illumina orbs onto Wishiwashi Solo Form, they will swim away only to swim back as Wailord is chasing them, mouth wide open. You will then see it swimming back as Wishiwashi has changed Form and is making chase against the Wailord
Skorupi appears all over the early part of the stage. It's often found hiding in sand mounts where it's often pulled out by Mandibuzz. It can also be sucked up into the tornado for a top quality shot

Cacnea appears rolling in the early part of the stage. This will also have it roll into a tornado for a four star shot. If you can stop the rolling you can also Prompt another good shot. In research Lv. 3, two Cacnea can be seen just looking up towards the sky. If you use scan close to the Cacnea down the sandslide to your left, the Cacnea will start rolling. You will then see them near the course exit chasing a Tumbleweed or, if you awoke the Minior, chase the Minior

Heliolisk appears in certain parts of the stage. One appears near the start where it will chase fluffruit or, if you use scan, it will open its solar generator up. Next, one is lying in the middle of the Oasis. If you can awaken it, it will run across the water for a 4 star photo opportunity and eventually run to another sleeping Heliolisk that appears by the craters. They will then show their frills at eachother for another 4 star photo opportunity.

Minior appears in the Day stage pretty early on. If you scan in the first dunes part, you will find one to the left and one to the sand bank just before you have the Crystabloom trio. Throw Illumina orbs to awaken them. If you do, random colour Minior will then appear at the end of the standard path. If you have awakened the Cacnea with Scan and led them there, the Cacnea will start chasing them

Mandibuzz appears throughout the stage flying around. They can be antagonistic towards other Pokémon, often swiping them out of Sand Dunes. On the right hand path by the Oasis, there are some coconuts sitting around. If you throw a fluffruit, Mandibuzz will rapidly fly down and take it, making and photograph the response if you can get it
Pinsir appears buried in the crater to the right in the left hand Oasis path. If you use Illumina orbs, it will pull itself out
Lycanroc appears on the rockface to the rig

Hippowdon can be seen outside around the Oasis. You can see some sleeping and others fighting. One appears in the Oasis and can be lured towards Torchic and photograph the response opportunity. Others will start fighting and will even topple over

Torchic appears at the start of the Oasis. It has a few interactions including burning off a fluffruit or you can lure it to the head of a Hippowdon using Illumina orbs for a 4 Star photo opportunity. You can also throw Illumina orbs at it and then feed it for another
Vivillon Sandstorm Pattern appears flying around the Trapinch crater

Flygon can be obtained by hitting the three Crystabloom. It will cause the tornado to disappear and Flygon will appear and start flying around. If it sees a fluffruit, it will take the fluffruit and fly away to the craters on the standard path and give it to some Trapinch.

A pit of Onix appears on the right hand path of the Oasis. When you Prompt to their area, they will start digging and will move around to Melody, Scanning and so forth. You can also Prompt one to jump out of the ground. If you hit all the Mandibuzz sitting in the area with a fluffruit, you can Prompt a good 4 star picture of Onix trying to jump out to get them

Tyranitar appears in the second path. It is sleeping but Lycanroc will then challenge it to a fight. It will win but will start punching a rock. If you light it up with an Illumina orb, it will destroy the rock and create a good photo opportunity. It will then run into the cave the rock opened.

Scorbunny appears behind a small rock to the right of the stage. If you can lure it out with a scan and Melody, it will start running around. Later, in the left Oasis path, Scorbunny can be seen running around the various craters.

Silicobra can be originally found in a busy on the left Oasis path. If you throw a fluffruit inside, then it will jump out before digging down into the ground. Several more Silicobra appears in the sand with their noses held out so it can be pulled upwards

Trapinch appears in the crater towards the end of the normal path. They are stuck in the ground but can be knocked out by a fluffruit. If you have freed Flygon and given Flygon a fluffruit, it will come down to feed them. If you throw an Illumina orb at Scorbunny, it will dig up various Trapinch so multiple can be seen at the end
Magikarp appears using fluffruit into the Oasis. This will then startle Heliolisk and cause it to run off

Skorupi can be seen near the course entrance. There are two Skorupi that will walk up a hill near the course entrance towards the Silicobra. Another will get hit by the Orange Core Minior as it comes flying down

Three Trapinch can be seen near the course entrance. They will start walking but will eventually fall asleep In the righthand Oasis path, a Trapinch appears half in the sand. In the left-hand patch, two Trapinch appears sleeping in the crater with Flygon

Sandshrew appears rolling around in the first part of the stage. If you hit it with a fluffruit while it is rolling, it will jump out for a special photo. Right path of the Oasis will see a Sandshrew getting chased by a Lycanroc Midnight Form. Then, when you get into the Minior area, one will play with a Minior Red Core

A Kangaskhan can be seen near the course entrance staring up at the stars. Another one appears sat by the Oasis. If you manage to free the Red Core and Orange Core Minior, they will fly over to the Kangaskhan at the Oasis and put her at ease, allowing her to play with her baby or, if you are nearby enough to through fluffruit, feed her offspring. Both are 4 star interactions

Lycanroc Midnight Form appears around the Oasis. They are more territorial than their counterparts but will walk around. In research Lv. 1, they will refuse fluffruit but research Lv. 2 will have them eat it. One on the right hand path will chase a Sandshrew that rolled out of the cave. On the lefthand path, another will be patrolling the craters. If you activate the Crystabloom and lure it to Tyranitar, a fight will break out for a 3 star photo
Magikarp appears using a fluffruit into the Oasis

Hippowdon appears sleeping in this stage. One appears by the Oasis. Then, in the left path you will find two more sleeping by the craters In the right path, you will find one sleeping under a sandfall
Two Cacnea appears rolling down the hill near the start of the level. In the Onix area, another appears walking around

Three Minior Meteorite Form appears embedded in the sand early on in the stage, many detectable only by scanning. If you let it go using Illumina orbs, it will immediately fly off. Another Meteorite Form will fall in the part where there are three Crystablooms. If you hit all three so they are lit up at the same time, it will come flying down. It will need you to hit the nearby Crystabloom to be dragged out of the sand. Another hidden Meteor Form will be in the sand nearby. If you scan right to the bottom right when you start and release the Minior, then release two hidden in the dunes behind Trapinch, then two more hidden by the big rock to your right, then one poking out by the dune with Kangaskhan on, then one more next to Silicobra, then restore the one that hits Skorupi and the two that come down from th Crystabloom, a formating of Minior will fly through the Oasis for a 4 star photo

If you light up all three Minior Core, a Red Minior will fly down alongside it, but will need use of Illumina orbs to bring it out. When you are in the Onix part of the stage, the cores will slam down to the ground and come out of their shell. They often need a landing bed through use of Illumina orbs to Prompt them to land. The Red Core at the start will just float around and can be interacted with. Another Red Core and subsequent other cores will start to fall out. The ones to the right of the exit will then have a meteor shower If you scan right to the bottom right when you start and release the Minior, then release two hidden in the dunes behind Trapinch, then two more hidden by the big rock to your right, then one poking out by the dune with Kangaskhan on, then one more next to Silicobra, then restore the one that hits Skorupi and the two that come down from th Crystabloom, a formating of Minior will fly through the Oasis for a 4 star photo

The Blue Core will come down close to a rock pillar but will be unable to float out by itself. If you use an Illumina orb, it will float upwards by itself If you scan right to the bottom right when you start and release the Minior, then release two hidden in the dunes behind Trapinch, then two more hidden by the big rock to your right, then one poking out by the dune with Kangaskhan on, then one more next to Silicobra, then restore the one that hits Skorupi and the two that come down from th Crystabloom, a formating of Minior will fly through the Oasis for a 4 star photo

The Green Core will come down to the right of the exit and immediately start creating a meteor shower with the other Minior If you scan right to the bottom right when you start and release the Minior, then release two hidden in the dunes behind Trapinch, then two more hidden by the big rock to your right, then one poking out by the dune with Kangaskhan on, then one more next to Silicobra, then restore the one that hits Skorupi and the two that come down from th Crystabloom, a formating of Minior will fly through the Oasis for a 4 star photo

Early on in the stage, a Minior will slam down and hit a Skorupi. It will be stuck in the sand but can be lured out with Illumina orbs. In the Onix area, the Orange Core will come down to the right of the exit and immediately start creating a meteor shower with the other Minior. In the left hand area, an Orange Core Minior will sometimes fly down by Tyranitar if you throw an Illumina orb at it If you scan right to the bottom right when you start and release the Minior, then release two hidden in the dunes behind Trapinch, then two more hidden by the big rock to your right, then one poking out by the dune with Kangaskhan on, then one more next to Silicobra, then restore the one that hits Skorupi and the two that come down from th Crystabloom, a formating of Minior will fly through the Oasis for a 4 star photo

The Indigo Core will come down to the right of the exit and immediately start creating a meteor shower with the other Minior If you scan right to the bottom right when you start and release the Minior, then release two hidden in the dunes behind Trapinch, then two more hidden by the big rock to your right, then one poking out by the dune with Kangaskhan on, then one more next to Silicobra, then restore the one that hits Skorupi and the two that come down from th Crystabloom, a formating of Minior will fly through the Oasis for a 4 star photo

The Violet Core will come down to the left of the area if you have brought all the Minior out of the ground up to that point. It will then create a shower with the other Minior If you scan right to the bottom right when you start and release the Minior, then release two hidden in the dunes behind Trapinch, then two more hidden by the big rock to your right, then one poking out by the dune with Kangaskhan on, then one more next to Silicobra, then restore the one that hits Skorupi and the two that come down from th Crystabloom, a formating of Minior will fly through the Oasis for a 4 star photo

The Yellow Core will come down to the right of the exit and immediately start creating a meteor shower with the other Minior If you scan right to the bottom right when you start and release the Minior, then release two hidden in the dunes behind Trapinch, then two more hidden by the big rock to your right, then one poking out by the dune with Kangaskhan on, then one more next to Silicobra, then restore the one that hits Skorupi and the two that come down from th Crystabloom, a formating of Minior will fly through the Oasis for a 4 star photo
Mandibuzz is found around the Oasis just standing and watching. If you hit it with a fluffruit, it will anger and fly off

Onix appears sleeping in the area on the righthand path but will be woken up by the Minior and can be woken by Illumina orbs. If you see one far away, hit it with an Illumina orb and it will jump into the air and into the ground

Silicobra appears sleeping on the sand dunes near the start. Once you have hit it with a fluffruit, it will dive down into the sand. It can then be found embedded in the sand opposite the Minior Crystablooms. If you knock it up there, then it will appear near the Oasis. If you lure Lycanroc to it, it will jump out and attack Lycanroc for a 4 star picture, afterwards it'll be angry with a 3 star picture. Another appears under a rock formation in the Minior part of the stage

Tyranitar appears sleeping by a crater in the left hand side of the stage. It will be hidden by a twister but if you hit the nearby Crystabloom, it will come out. You can lure Lycanroc over to it for a fight for another 4 star photo

Flygon appears in the first crater following the left Oasis route. It can be awakened with fluffruit and Illumina orbs. If it's hit by an Illumina orb, it will fly around in an aerobatic style to shake the energy off. It will then return to the Trapinch in the crater

Vivillon Sun Pattern is a rather complex Pokémon to find. To Prompt it, you need to go down the right path and throw fluffruit at the Lycanroc repeatedly until they all go away. If you then hit the Crystabloom by the Oasis, the Sun Pattern Vivillon will spawn by the Oasis. If you hit the Sandshrew rolling in the first area with a fluffruit, then a pair will come before you activate the Crystabloom. It is a 3 star photo

Vivillon Savanna Pattern is a rather complex Pokémon to find. To Prompt it, you need to go down the right path and throw fluffruit at the Lycanroc repeatedly until they all go away. If you then hit the Crystabloom by the Oasis, the Savanna Pattern Vivillon will spawn behind you. If you hit the Sandshrew rolling in the first area with a fluffruit, then a pair will come before you activate the Crystabloom. It is a 4 star photo

Altaria appears at the start of hte stage in all Leevels. It will be flying around or sitting in the hot springs. It will start dancing if you turn the Melody on. In Volcano (research Lv. 1), after the Luxray scare the Altaria away, throw some fluffruit into the small Hotsprings to release some steam to make Altaria happy. Take a photo for a 4 star photo

Luxray appears through multiple parts of the stage. At the start a couple will be roaming the hot springs. In research Lv. 3, one of the Luxray needs to be reunited with a Shinx and photograph the response opportunity. In research Lv. 3, reunite the Shinx and Luxray in the first area. Then, as you enter the canyon, throw a fluffruit at the Tyrantrum that is chasing Archeops. The Luxray will come in to your rescue and face down the Tyrantrum. If you hit the far Luxray with an Illumina orb, it will use Discharge for a 4 Star PhotoIn the standard path, you will find another just sitting on a rock. Hit it with Illumina orbs to light its eyes up. In the Blue Magma path, you will find another far away in the volcano crevice. If you hit it with Illumina orbs, it will find Vivillon

Archeops has got a few appearances throughout the stage. In research Lv. 1 and beyond, you can find it in the main craters flying around. In research Lv. 2 onwards, you will see it in the valley area being chased by other Archeops or Tyrantrum. You can also spot one with a Charmander. In the Blue Magma path, you will see some Archeops flying overhead when Ho-Oh is flying through

Graveler appears in a couple of areas. First it will be on the walls of various parts of the internal parts of the volcano. In the final part, if you knock it down, it will then roll down and hit the ruins. In the Blue Magma cave path, you will see one hanging on above a molten rock. Knock it down for a big impact. Another appears near the blue magma drop staring at it. If you throw a fluffruit at it, it will roll away

Aerodactyl appears in a couple of areas. First it is found in the valley area sitting on parts of the rocks. Otherwise it is flying around the area. In research Lv. 2, you can Prompt it to land using fluffruit at the Typhlosion in the final area. There, you can Prompt it to eat a fluffruit for a 4 star picture Another appears as you hit the crossroads in the path flying around the rockfaces

Slugma appears in the internal parts of the Volcano. On the standard path, you can find Slugma climbing the walls and down the lava. If you can lure it, you can even Photograph Slugma climbing up a lavafall. In the Blue Magma path, you can find it in the Blue Magma room, and it'll be happy when you light it up with the Crystablooms

Tyrantrum appears in a couple of places. First in the valley, you will see it chasing other Pokémon and fighting with itself or Monferno. If you interrupt its hunt, it will start chasing you. Getting a picture of it roaring will give you a high quality image In research Lv. 2, Tyrantrum will be blocking the standard path by sleeping. In research Lv. 3, a Tyrantrum appears in the standard path having a fight with a Charizard

Monferno appears in a variety of parts of the stage. In the early part of the stage, they will be in the rocks and taunt the Aerodactyl and Tyrantrum. When you get inside the cave, you will find a pair playing and climbing the walls. In the Blue Magma path, you will see a couple of Monferno on the ramps up out of the volcano crater towards the end

Charmander appears throughout the stage. First there is a Charmander playing hide and seek in the immediate right of where you start and can be lured out with fluffruit, Shinx will also sometimes join it. Later on, you will find one talking to an Archeops in research Lv. 3, throw an Illumina orb to Prompt it to do its 4 star animation. Inside the cave, you will see a couple more Charmander in the chamber with Tyrantrum and Charizard. in the Blue Magma path, you will find two Charmander in the magma rock crater as you approach the Blue Magma chamber and they will run away if you knock Graveler down. Another will be in the Blue Magma chamber

Shinx appears near the course entrance in research Lv. 2 in a pair. In research Lv. 3, a Shinx is lost in the same area. You can lead it to the nearby Luxray with fluffruit and photograph the responsegraph. If you do reunite them, you will see them together at the end of the Blue Magma cave. In research Lv. 3, reunite the Shinx and Luxray in the first area. Then, as you enter the canyon, throw a fluffruit at the Tyrantrum that is chasing Archeops. The Luxray will come in to your rescue and face down the Tyrantrum. In the Blue Magma path, you can find a Shinx next to the Graveler in research Lv. 2 or sleeping with a Flareon in research Lv. 3. They can be adjusted and made happy with the Crystablooms

Talonflame starts to appear in research Lv. 2 and flies around the outside area, sometimes landing. In research Lv. 3, more Talonflame will appear and fly closer to the camera. When the two Tyrantrum start fighting, Talonflame will screech at them then fly away. Grab the screech for a 3 Star shot. If you can get it grab a fluffruit, that is a 4 star shot. Another Talonflame is seen in the standard path inside the cave

Typhlosion appears in the Blue Magma path. A pair of them will be at the bottom of the crater and can be given fluffruit and Illumina orbs to Prompt them to use Flamethrower on the fluffruit for a 4 star photo. If you have lured Charizard to the area, then it will have a fight for a 3 star photo Another appears at the start in research Lv. 3 and will chase an Archeops away. Hit Typhlosion with a fluffruit at the start of a stage. Then, shortly after, see it interacting with an Aerodactyl. Throw an Illumina orb to Prompt it to use Eruption for a 4 star photo

Torkoal appears starting research Lv. 2. It is found sleeping in the Blue Magma cavern and can be woken up with the Illumina orb. One will be sleeping on top of a Rainbow Wing if you took a photo of Ho-Oh. In the standard path, another Torkoal appears sleeping in the main chamber and if you are quick, you can Photograph it on its hind legs

Flareon appears within the Blu Magma cavern part of the cave after you reach research Lv. 3. There will be two Flareon within the cave, one sleeping with a Shinx and another who will jump in to shot immediately. They can be lured to eachother to Photograph them releasing their flames. Another Flareon can be seen on the standard path sleeping in the cavern where Tyrantrum and Charizard are fighting

Charizard appears within the main structure towards the end of the stage. It will be fighting with a Tyrantrum and constantly flying around. If you Photograph it roaring, it'll be a four star photograph while it flying around will be lower stars If you Illumina orb the three Charmander on the way into the volcano, one at the start, one by the Crystabloom and one with Archeops, then Prompt to the Blue Magma Path. Throw Illumina orbs at both Charmander and then knock the Graveler down for a Charizard to appear, which is a 4 star photo. It will fly off into the main chamber where it will fly around. When it lands, Illumina orb it for a Flamethrower 4 star photo. It will also then fight with Typhlosion or, if you scare the Typhlosion away, it will be around to roar for a 3 star photo

Vivillon's High Plains pattern is a tricky one to get. In order to Prompt this to appear, you need to go down the Blue Magma path. When at the final bit, you will see a Luxray on the far side of the volcano. If you can throw an Illumina orb at it, it will start looking for something and then run off. Two Vivillon will then fly in at a distance. If you feed the Typhlosion and they run off, then a High Plains Vivillon will fly through the ruins

Ho-Oh will appear in the skies at the start of the level. If you Photograph it, then continue the course through the right hand Blue Magma part of the stage. Along the stage you will find three Rainbow Wings. One will be in the left side of the tunnel that has Graveler and the crater, another under a sleeping Torkoal and another in the Blue Magma chamber. Throw Illumina orbs at all three and, at the end, Ho-Oh will appear. If you hit 2 wings, then it will just fly up, but if you hit all 3 it will descend and start flying around, activated for the special 4 star shots

Volcarona is the fourth Illumina Pokémon to encounter, with a twist: There are two of them. Volcarona will both shield themselves with aura of fire. To remove the fire, you need to hit them with two fluffruits before you can use Illumina orbs On subsequent visits, several Pokémon will interact with Volcarona such as attacking them in the air.
Monferno can be seen on a path on the sides going up the mountain. If Volcarona is lit up with Illumina Energy when it goes near it, it will send energy to Monferno for a 3 star photo

Talonflame can be seen in multiple parts of the stage, most notably as you go through a tunnel. It will face off against the Volcarona if you remove the shield and Orb Volcarona on the side of the tunnel where you came from

Archeops can be seen in multiple parts of the stage, most notably as you go through a tunnel. It will face off against the Volcarona if you remove the shield and Orb Volcarona on the side of the tunnel where you are going. Towards the end of the stage, two Archeops will fly up to the top and do some aerial acrobatics with the Volcarona

Tepig appears in the start of the stage playing around before moving onwards towards the middle of the stage. In Research research Lv. 3, you will find a Tepig, Shinx and Torchic running across the valley. In research Lv. 3, towards the end, lure Koffing down to Tepig by hitting it with a fluffruit. Then, Illumina orb both and it'll use Smokescreen. Kangaskhan will put Tepig in its pouch. Photograph it with Tepig in its pouch

Diglett appears throughout the stage. If you throw fluffruit at the Diglett, they will move and start playing to catch the fluffruit, with Rockruff watching and enjoying it. More Diglett will pop out throughout the stage, requiring Illumina orbs to stay out If you take the alternate path, there will be three Torchic on the cliffside to the left. If you lure them together and then illumina Orb them, a Diglett will pop out startling them for a 4 star photo.

near the course entrance, there are multiple Mandibuzz flying around and two sitting down. If you hit the two sitting with fluffruit, they will fly away. In the final part of the stage, a Mandibuzz can be seen walking around. Feed it a fluffruit and photograph the response chance.
Hippowdon can be seen to the left near the course entrance not able to do much interaction

Two Minior appears embedded in the ground towards the top of the first area but, if you hit the Crystabloom, another will come crashing down for a 4 star photo. Another Minior appears embedded near the craters

Silicobra appears in multiple places in the day. You will find one hidden in the dirt by Tepig as you progress through the level. If you knock it out of the ground with a fluffruit and then illumina Orb it, it will attack the Tepig for a 4 star photo. On research Lv. 2 & 3, you will see two to the far left by a sleeping Scolipede. One will jump onto the Scolipede and use a Sand Spit which will awaken and anger the Scolipede. The jump and the Sand Spit are 4 and 3 star photo opportunities respectively. After that, Scolipede will chase the Silicobra throughout the stage. If you stop the Scolipede, it will appear near the course exit. If you use an Illumina orb on the first one, you get a 3 star photo. If you hit the last one with a fluffruit, it will spit out sand for a 4 star photo

Swalot appears in the Swamp and can get a 3 Star Photo with it with its mouth open wide. In research Lv. 3, if you throw a fluffruit towards the Salazzle, a Koffing will come up and Swalot will suck it in for a 4 star photo before sending it flying.

Koffing appears in the Swamp area. One will be hidden behind the rock and attracted with Melody. In research Lv. 2 and higher, more appears. If you lure one to a Crystabloom and then activate it, it will grow to a giant size for a 4 star photo opportunity. In research Lv. 3, if you throw a fluffruit towards the Salazzle, then a Koffing will be sent down and sucked up by Swalot for a 4 star photo opportunity, and then projectile fired out for a 3 star photo opportunity

Shinx appears in a few places. In research Lv. 1, it will be with Tepig and Torchic at the end before the craters. In research Lv. 2 it appears playing amongst the crater. In research Lv. 3, it will run across the valley with Tepig and Shinx. If you go the alternate path, you will find one sleeping in the valley with a Scolipede

Torchic appears in a few places. In research Lv. 1, it will be with Tepig and Shinx at the end before the craters, but Torchic will then run ahead. In research Lv. 3, it will run across the valley with Tepig and Shinx. If you take the alternate path, there will be three Torchic on the cliffside to the left. If you lure them together and then illumina Orb them, a Diglett will pop out startling them for a 4 star photo. You will also find one sleeping alongside a Scolipede

Lycanroc appears in many parts of the stage. In Research research Lv. 2, you can find one sleeping to the left of the path as you head towards the Swamp Path. Then, another appears at the end by the craters for a variety of photos. In the alternate path, you can find another Lycanroc playing with a Rockruff for some good photo opportunities
Onix appears in the craters towards the end. It will sometimes poke its head out but will sometimes jump between the two craters

Crustle appears walking around the first main area of the stage. However, in Research research Lv. 2 and up, two appears fighting for a 3 Star Photo. If you Illumina orb one of the Crustle, then it will tip the other one for another good photo. Another Crustle can be seen near the Illumina orb in the valley and will hide when Scolipede runs past

Rockruff appears in research Lv. 2 and up near the course entrance. It will be playing with Tepig and Diglett. If you throw fluffruit at the Diglett, they will move and start playing to catch the fluffruit, with Rockruff watching and enjoying it. On the Alternate path, you will find a Rockruff playing with a Lycanroc

Kangaskhan appears playing with its child to the right of the start of the stage in Research Levels 2 and up. Another appears by the craters. If at the start you lure Salazzle to it, they will battle and Kangaskhan will then roar and photograph the response opportunity. In research Lv. 3, towards the end, lure Koffing down to Tepig by hitting it with a fluffruit. Then, Illumina orb both and it'll use Smokescreen. Kangaskhan will put Tepig in its pouch. Photograph it with Tepig in its pouch

Scolipede appears in two places. From research Lv. 2 onwards, one is sleeping to the left of the start of the stage and awakened by Silicobra. It then makes chase against the Silicobra appearing multiple times throughout the stage. In the alternate path, you will find two Scolipede fighting, which is a 3 Star photo. However, if you Illumina orb one of them and Photograph that one while it's attacking, you will get a 4 Star Photo

Salazzle is in a couple of parts of the stage. First it will be at the very front hidden behind a rock with Mandibuzz on top. If you hit the Mandibuzz with a fluffruit, play Melody and Salazzle will come out. After it dances, it will set of a pose for a 4 star photo. You can then lead it to the sandfall with a scent using fluffruit and it will start kicking sand up at itself for a 3 star photo. Alternatively, if you lure it to the Kangaskhan, it will start flexing its poison for a 4 star photo. Later on, another Salazzle appears on top of the poison gas volcano. In research Lv. 3, Salazzle will be lured out after you awaken Zeraora. It will chasse after Zeraora and stop in the Poison Swamp on a cliff looking over. If you use an illumina Orb, it will glow for a 3 star photo

In research Lv. 3, Zeraora will appear sleeping on the cave to the right as you go through the standard path. If you hit it with a fluffruit, it will run towards the end of the stage. At the final part of the stage, it will just be walking around. If you feed it a fluffruit, you will get a 3 Star photo

In research Lv. 1, Rockruff appears at the start playing with Torchic, Shinx, and Tepig. They will rush to the Geyser and play around it until the Geyser erupts in which case they'll disperse. Later, at the swamp, Rockruff appears sleeping on the cliff. If you awaken it and Prompt it to Howl, you will Prompt a 4 star photo. In research Lv. 2, Rockruff appears near the course entrance playing again. However, afterwards it is found in the alternate path sleeping alongside Torchic, Shinx and Tepig. if you don't awaken it in time, Mandibuzz will come and scare them away. If you do, and then hit it with an Illumina orb, it will howl to scare off the Mandibuzz for a top quality picture

In research Lv. 1, Torchic appears at the start playing with Rockruff, Shinx, and Tepig. They will rush to the Geyser and play around it until the Geyser erupts in which case they'll disperse. Later they will appear near the course exit poking their heads through the holes. If you photograph them, they will each individually appear at the end and will celebrate and photograph the response. In research Lv. 2, it appears sleeping with Rockruff and its friends on the alternate path. If Rockruff isn't awakened, then they will run off scared. If Rockruff is awakened, then Rockruff will defend and they will then celebrate for a decent photo. If you awaken it instead of Rockruff, and then hit it with an Illumina orb, it will howl to scare off the Mandibuzz for a top quality picture

In research Lv. 1, Shinx appears at the start playing with Rockruff, Torchic, and Tepig. They will rush to the Geyser and play around it until the Geyser erupts in which case they'll disperse. Later they will appear near the course exit poking their heads through the holes. If you photograph them, they will each individually appear at the end and will celebrate for a 4 Star photo. In research Lv. 2, it appears sleeping with Rockruff and its friends on the alternate path. If Rockruff isn't awakened, then they will run off scared. If Rockruff is awakened, then Rockruff will defend and they will then celebrate for a 4 Star photo. If you awaken it instead of Rockruff, and then hit it with an Illumina orb, it will howl to scare off the Mandibuzz for a top quality picture

In research Lv. 1, Tepig appears at the start playing with Rockruff, Shinx, and Torchic. They will rush to the Geyser and play around it until the Geyser erupts in which case they'll disperse. Later they will appear near the course exit poking their heads through the holes. If you photograph them, they will each individually appear at the end and will celebrate and photograph the response. In research Lv. 2, it appears sleeping with Rockruff and its friends on the alternate path. If Rockruff isn't awakened, then they will run off scared. If Rockruff is awakened, then Rockruff will defend and they will then celebrate for a decent photo. If you awaken it instead of Rockruff, and then hit it with an Illumina orb, it will howl to scare off the Mandibuzz for a top quality picture

The Vivillon appears near the course entrance on various trees and the giant boulder. In research Lv. 2, three Vivillon will fly at the start. If you throw an Illumina orb at them, they will fly through and activate other ones and head towards the valley. As they go towards the valley, if you had activated the alternate path, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear and photograph the response opportunity In research Lv. 2, if you awaken the one on the cliffface by Illumina orbing the trailing Sandstorm Pattern, and you send Gliscor to the left cliff by hitting it with a fluffruit, Vivillon will use Sleep Powder on the Gliscor and photograph the response opportunity

The Vivillon appears near the course entrance on various trees and the giant boulder. In research Lv. 2, three Vivillon will fly at the start. If you throw an Illumina orb at them, they will fly through and activate other ones and head towards the valley. As they go towards the valley, if you had activated the alternate path, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear and photograph the response opportunity

The Vivillon appears near the course entrance on various trees and the giant boulder. In research Lv. 2, three Vivillon will fly at the start. If you throw an Illumina orb at them, they will fly through and activate other ones and head towards the valley. As they go towards the valley, if you had activated the alternate path, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear and photograph the response opportunity

Crustle appears walking around the area and by the geyser throughout the stage. In research Lv. 2, if you awaken Tyranitar from behind, it will go and attack Crustle, knocking it over with a tail attack. If you Photograph Crustle on its back, then you will get a 4 Star Photo

Mandibuzz appears flying around the stage in research Lv. 1. In research Lv. 2, one will fly up to the sleeping Rockruff & friends and photograph the response. If you awaken the Rockruff, they will fight

Diglett appears all throughout the stage in a variety of areas. They will often be underground and will require you to use an Illumina orb to bring them up. In research Lv. 1, a line of Diglett appears and when Illumina orbed, will move towards the later level. A group can also be found just before entering the path. In research Lv. 2, 8 different Diglett appears in the opening area. If you awaken at least 4 and then activate the Crystabloom, they will activate the alternate path for a 3 Star Photo. Later, another group appears in the valley by the Crystabloom. Activate the Crystabloom for them to pop out. Finally, Diglett appears in the various holes near the course exit. The more you interacted with throughout the stage, the more that appears there. if you photograph them all, they will appear at the end for a group photo. If you Prompt 2 or more in one hole, that is a 4 star photo. In the alternate path, you can send a Diglett over to Kangaskhan by Illumina orb then photo for a fun 1 Star photo

Lycanroc can primarily be found in research Lv. 1. In research Lv. 1, a Lycanroc can be seen walking along to the left of the start of the stage and will walk towards the end. In the Swamp Path, if you awaken the Rockruff sleeping on the cliff and Illumina orb it, then Lycanroc will jump up there and the two will Howl together for a 4 star photo. After that, the Lycanroc appears sleeping in the prea to the right of the final path
Swalot appears in the Poison Swamp towards the end. In research Lv. 2, if you activate the Crystabloom, all the sleeping Swalot will jump out for a 3 Star photo opportunity

Scolipede appears in two areas. First is the Swamp. In research Lv. 1, one will be walking around the swamp and if the Crystabloom is activated, it will roll around in the swamp or lure it over to the rocks for a 3 Star photo orfor a 3 Star photo. In research Lv. 2, it will be sleeping next to the swamp but will wake up if Sandshrew rolls into it. Then, if you got Gliscor down to it, you will get a fight with Gliscor. In research Lv. 1, Scolipede appears sleeping on an overhanging cliff

Kangaskhan appears simply sleeping towards the end of the stage, though it will wake up if fluffruit thrown at it. In research Lv. 2, two appears in the area In the alternate path, you can send a Diglett over to Kangaskhan by Illumina orb then photo for a fun 1 Star photo. If you help Rockruff against Mandibuzz, then Mandibuzz will interact with it. If you wake the Lycanroc up, Lycanroc will interact

In research Lv. 1, Tyranitar appears walking out of the cave behind you as you start. In research Lv. 2, Tyranitar is a bit more complex. It appears sleeping on the other side of the geyser. If you wake it up while you're in its sight, it will roar at you and photograph the response opportunity. If you awaken it from behind, it will move over to a Crustel and attack the Crustle for a 4 star photo opportunity. If you awaken Zeraora and then awaken Tyranitar from behind, the two will start to fight for a 4 star photo opportunity

In research Lv. 2, Magikarp will be sent out of the Geyser rapidly right near the course entrance, and will flop up if you use an Illumina orb. If you activate the alternate path, they will all sweim back into the geyser

Gliscor appears in research Lv. 2. One will fly around the main area as you go through and do a loop and photograph the response. As you go towards the swamp, you will see multiple sleeping upside down. If you awaken them with fluffruit, they will fly down to the swamp and can be fed fluffruit for a 3 star photo. Another will fly towards a crater and Prompt hit by the impact of a Minior for a 3 Star photo. If you got Sandshrew to roll down and wake the Scolipede and got the Gliscor to be almost hit by Minior, the two will then fight fgor a 4 star photo If you go the alternate route and have Illumina orbed the Vivillon, you will find a Gliscor waiting for you, hit it with a fluffruit and it will move to the left. The Vivillon will then fly up to it and use Sleep Powder for a 3 Star photo. After that, it will then Yawn for a 4 Star photo

Sandshrew appears in research Lv. 2. A pair will be found to the left of the stage and can play while another will be within a group of Diglett on the standard path. If you Illumina orb one on the left, it will roll down. Then, Illumina orb a Diglett and they will interact. Later, it will climb out of the ground for a 3 star photo. It will then also roll down the swamp and wake the Scolipede up

Minior only appears briefly in the stage. As you reach the end with the three craters, three Minior Meteor Form will come slamming down into the ground. If you manage to grab a picture, you will get a 4 star photo

To Prompt the Vivillon, you need to Illumina orb the three Vivillon flying away from you at the start of the level. Then, Illumina orb and photograph at least 5 Diglett and hit the Crystabloom to take the alternate path. As they go towards the valley, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear

To Prompt the Vivillon, you need to Illumina orb the three Vivillon flying away from you at the start of the level. Then, Illumina orb and photograph at least 5 Diglett and hit the Crystabloom to take the alternate path. As they go towards the valley, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear

To Prompt the Vivillon, you need to Illumina orb the three Vivillon flying away from you at the start of the level. Then, Illumina orb and photograph at least 5 Diglett and hit the Crystabloom to take the alternate path. As they go towards the valley, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear

To Prompt the Vivillon, you need to Illumina orb the three Vivillon flying away from you at the start of the level. Then, Illumina orb and photograph at least 5 Diglett and hit the Crystabloom to take the alternate path. As they go towards the valley, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear

To Prompt the Vivillon, you need to Illumina orb the three Vivillon flying away from you at the start of the level. Then, Illumina orb and photograph at least 5 Diglett and hit the Crystabloom to take the alternate path. As they go towards the valley, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear

To Prompt the Vivillon, you need to Illumina orb the three Vivillon flying away from you at the start of the level. Then, Illumina orb and photograph at least 5 Diglett and hit the Crystabloom to take the alternate path. As they go towards the valley, hit the Crystabloom beneath the valley and the rest of the Vivillon will appear

Zeraora appears in the Badlands (Night) stage. Once you reach research Lv. 2, you will see it to the left sleeping. If you wake it up, it will run around the stage and settle on a cliffside. If you then awaken Tyranitar while out of sight, the two will fight allowing for good photo opportunities. If you get it while doing a flip while jumping, it is a 3 star animation while if you get it attacking, it is a 4 star photo. If you take the alternate path and waken it just before riding up the geyser, if you turbo you can collide with Zeraora and it will appear running towards you at the very end

Furret appears in the first area of the stage, running around and frolicking with eachother. There are also several holes near the end of the forest area with a Crystablooms. hit the Crystablooms and it will jump out

Swinub appears in a couple of places. Notably it will be in the area alongside the Mamoswine. reach, from research Lv. 2 upwards, you will see a pair running up the hill to the tundra. If you hit the m with Illumina orbs, they will increase their speed. FInally, towards the end of the normal path of the stage, there will be a couple there. You have the ability to lead them to find a hot spring geyser for a 4 star photo

Beartic appears in the forest area running through and looking for its Cubchoo friend. It will also rage when it is attacked and will protect the Cubchoo at all costs. Another appears in the final part of the stage

Cubchoo appears in the forest area at the start of the game with the Beartic. It will hang around its Beartic friend and, in research Lv. 3, will even play a game of Hide-and-Seek with it, finding it using a fluffruit at the top of the Igloo, and photograph the response opportunity. Another Cubchoo appears with a Mamoswine in the far part of the Icy Cave Path
Magikarp appears in the water using fluffruit at the water. It will then jump up

Multiple Mamoswine appears in the tundra with Swinub. Lure Weavile to the tree with the scratches and then hit it with an Illumina orb causing it to run up the hill. Then, throw a fluffruit at the Swinub on the left at the top of the hill to start a fight between the Weavile and the Mamoswine. Then, throw an Illumina orb at the Weavile and Photograph Mamoswine as it puts its tusks under the snow to counterattack for a 4 star photo. Another Mamoswine appears in the far part of the Icy Cave path, just before the exit alongside a Piplup, a Swinub and a Cubchoo

Skarmory appears flying over the tundra area and forest area of the stage, slightly out of reach. reach, in the final part of the Icy Cave path, beyond the water, you will see a small hole in a cave. Throw a fluffruit in there and Skarmory will rapidly fly out in an aerial display

Snorunt appears in the standard cave. The three are agitated and require help to calm down through helping it. Another pair of Snorunt are embedded in the ground and will rise up when hit with Illumina orbs

Snom appears at the top of the path when you enter the cave in the standard path. It will sit on the top of the ramp, slightly out of view. If you go via the Snow Wall path, you will see Snom by various trees in the blizzard, but when the blizzard takes hold, they will dig in to the ground. Photograph all 3 and then light up the Crystabloom to lure Frosmoth and get a 4 star photo

If you go via the Snow Wall path, you will see Snom by various trees in the blizzard, but when the blizzard takes hold, they will dig in to the ground. Photograph all 3 and then light up the Crystabloom to lure Frosmoth and get a 4 star photo
Glalie appears in the final cave on the standard path sitting by the Crystablooms. If it is then hit when awoken, it will create an icy armor around itself. Another appears sleeping in the Icy Cave
Spheal appears in the final area of the stage. They will roll around the area and then enter the riverbed where they will lie on their back as the current takes them
Piplup appears in the final area of the standard stage, playing around the water. A trio can also be found on the icebergs looking down at some treasure in the Icy Cave
The Tundra Pattern Vivillon can be seen flying off in the distance in the tundra

In research Lv. 1, Froslass appears in the standard cave sleeping by the Crystablooms. In research Lv. 3, one will be there alongside a Glalie. Awaken it and it will disappear in a blizzard. Throw fluffruit at it to Prompt it to use an attack for a 4 star picture. Another appears in the Icy Cave and it'll also disappear

Alolan Sandslash will appear from research Lv. 2 of the stage. Immediately to the left you will see an Alolan Sandslash. Photograph it and it'll dig down for another photo opportunity. Keep photographing it and it'll create a path through the Snow Wall. Another can be seen in the blizzard area and will dig up and down. If you hit it with an Illumina orb, it will stay out of the area. Feed it a fluffruit or wait for it to give a smile expression for a 4 star photo and it will then appear in the Icy Cave

Alolan Vulpix appears near the end part of the stage. In the first level, it is very timid and will immediately run away, but it is more personable in research Lv. 3 and will react to music, fluffruit and so forth

Weavile can be spotted in a few areas. First in research Lv. 2 and 3 it appears at the very start of the stage. One will have a special interaction if you lead it to the tree where there are scratches. Another pair appears in the tundra area and end up having a small fight with some Mamoswine
Abomasnow appears as you enter the blizzard area beyond the snow wall. It can be seen moving around and can be photographed within it

Crabominable can first be found in the blizzard area beyond the snow wall. If you look to the left, you'll find an unknown Pokémon. photograph it and throw an Illumina orb and, when you Prompt close to the end of the area, it will jump in and get you a close up. Another appears in the outside area punching some ice.
A swarm of Polar Pattern Vivillon appears inside the Icy Cave.
In Research research Lv. 3, a pack of Mightyena can be spotted in the distance of the outside following the Icy Cave path. If you use the Scan feature, they will howl.

Glaceon appears on the top of the cliffs looking down and can be photographed from a distance. If you manage to take a photo, it will appear later on in the stage for a close up inside the icicles. Throw a fluffruit onto the island for it to jump out and eat it. If you throw an Illumina orb at it, you will Prompt it to use Diamond Dust

Vanilluxe appears inside the Icy Cave portion near the exit. If you manage to Prompt it to eat a fluffruit, it will be happy. If you Prompt Glalie to bite on Avalugg to scare Vanilluxe out of the cave. Then, near the end, throw the fluffruit into the hole in the side of the cave and Vanilluxe will jump out. Throw an Illumina orb at it and Photograph it using Frost Breath

A pair of Dewgong appears in a small pond to the left of the entrance to the Icy Cave. Another Dewgong is found as soon as you exit the Icy Cave. It will quickly swim off but will reappear in the water later. If you keep following it, it will eventually land on Avalugg and go for a ride

Avalugg can be spotted in the distance when going through the Icy Cave portion of the stage. Dewgong will eventually go and ride on it. In the cave, there is also a sleeping Avalugg in front of the Glalie in research Lv. 3, if you lure Glalie to it, it will bite its tail then it will come up for a 4 Star Photo

Mightyena is the main focal Pokémon of this section. In the forest area, it will rush in and chase the Pokémon away, with them hunting in packs. A couple will splinter off, with one digging at a log and another at an ice box. Another will be in the area behind the snow wall and will stare at you. They also have taken over the tundra area and will routinely chase Furret. If you rescue the Delibird and Photograph the one on the cliff behind the Snow Wall, at the end a pack of Mightyena will climb a cliff in the distance and howl at the aurora

Piplup is in a number of areas here. First a few Piplup will be in the forest and will hide when the Mightyena come. They will then disperse and exit the area when the coast is clear. In the forest area, an igloo appears. If you throw a fluffruit at the front, the igloo will collapse to show two Snorunt and a sleeping Piplup. Another batch will be in the final area and, in research Lv. 2, will be sliding along the frozen river before it hits the Spheal that Abomasnow has knocked in. If you hit the Spheal before Abomasnow does, then Piplup's race will be complete and thje winner will pose for a 4 Star photo Finally, there is a Piplup following a Delibird just before the end part of the stage on the Icy Cave route

Mamoswine appears in two areas of the stage. First, one will be sleeping in the hot springs in the far end of the stage. In addition to that, a group of Mamoswine will be roaming with Swinub in the coastal part of the Icy Cave path, slightly out of reach

In the forest area, an igloo appears. If you throw a fluffruit at the front, the igloo will collapse to show two Snorunt and a sleeping Piplup. A Snorunt appears hidden in the ground in the forest area. Snorunt appears in the Tundra part of the stage, playing around by the top of the hill down into the cave. There is also a couple of Snorunt jumping between icebergs in the Icy Cave portion of the stage

Braviary will initially just fly through over the forest. If you manage to photograph it there, then it will continue its flight over the Tundra where it will get close. near the course exit, you will also see a sleeping Braviary, which will wake up and fly off if hit with a fluffruit or Illumina orb

Furret can be seen in a couple of parts of this stage. First it will be in the forest and will run off away from the Mightyena that is constantly chasing it. After the Mightyena have dispersed and you climb the hill towardss the Tundra, another Furret will jump down and go to the tundra, only to be surprised by another Mightyena. In the Snow Wall are, a Furret will run in, being chased by a Weavile

Alolan Sandslash appears hidden in the snow sleeping in the Forest and Tundra areas of the stage. If you throw Illumina orbs at them, they will jump out of the snow. You will also find one moving around, throw an orb at it to Prompt it to jump out

Delibird will be found at multiple points in this stage. First it will greet you in the forest before being chased off by the Mightyena. reach, it will hide in the log, but can be lured out with a fluffruit. Delibird will store all the fluffruit it collects. You will next see it in the tundra. In research Lv. 1 it will be hidden in the hole to the right but at research Lv. 2 if you have rescued it, it will run along the cliffside. If you rescued it from the Mightyena and fed it a fluffruit and hit the Furret with an Illumina orb, it will throw the fluffruit at the Mightyena. In the Snow Wall area, If you awaken the sleeping Crabominable with two fluffruit and an Illumina orb, it will knock the tree with the Snom sleeping. The Snom will dig under ground but one will be slower. Hit it with an Illumina orb and Delibird will come with a fluffruit for the Snom It will also appear in the cave. To the right there's a small alcove and if you throw fluffruit, it will appear and collect it. Throw another and it will offer you one when Illumina orbed. It finally appears in the final part of the stage to give the fluffruit to other Pokémon. Another Delibird will lead a parade of two Piplup and a Snom in the end of the Icy Cave path

Abomasnow appears in a couple of places in the stage. First, it is in the Tundra part on the standard path, sleeping against a tree on the cliffside. Following that, it is playing in the final part of the stage where it runs and knocks three Spheal into the frozen river, blocking the path for the skiing Piplup. An Abomasnow is also asleep in the Snow Wall path. If Crabominable hits the tree after being hit by an Illumina orb, snow will fall on its head and it'll summon a snowstorm and Froslass

Vanilluxe appears in the cave between two Jynx. If you throw an Illumina orb at the nearby Crystablooms, then it will light up and be more exaggerated in its expressions. Once can also be found sleeping in the Icy Cave path of the stage

Jynx appears in multiple areas of this stage. First a group appear in the cave and can start dancing when Illumina orbs hit the Crystablooms. In the Icy Cave path, there are two Jynx. One is praying by the river while the other is by a Crystablooms in front of a frozen Aurorus. Finally, in research Lv. 2, a Jynx appears sitting on an Avalugg in the distance. If you manage to hit it with an Illumina orb, it will summon Suicune
Alolan Vulpix appears in the final part of the stage on the small island by the frozen river. It will play with the Piplup
Spheal appears in the final part of the standard path of the stage and will be knocked into the frozen river by Abomasnow and act as a barrier for the skiing Piplup

Swinub can be seen in two places of the stage. It is in the final area moving around the snow and on top of the cliffside there. More Swinub can be seen in the distance in the shoreline part of the Icy Cave path

Frosmoth appears in two places. First it can be attached to the glacier in the Tundra in research Lv. 1 whereit can be knocked off and will start flying away. It will then appear near the course exit, with another if you knocked one off during the Tundra area. Hit it with an Illumina orb for a 4 star photo In the path behind the Snow Wall, it appears on the top of a tree and can be knocked off with a fluffruit

Crabominable appears in the path behind the Snow Wall. It will be punching a tree and then will shift to another tree. If hit with an Illumina orb, it will hit the tree hard enough to knock snow off of it

Weavile has a brief appearance in the Snow Wall path part of the stage where it is seen chasing a Furret into the forested area. If you follow it, it will try to dive into a hole following Furret and photograph the response shoot

Snom appears in the tree in the Snow Wall path. As you Prompt towards the end of it, look at a tree to the left and you'll find the tree filled with sleeping Snom. If you awaken the sleeping Crabominable with two fluffruit and an Illumina orb, it will knock the tree with the Snom sleeping. The Snom will dig under ground but one will be slower. Hit it with an Illumina orb and Delibird will come with a fluffruit. Other Snom will then come up and celebrate. Take a photo for a 4 star photo Beyond that, if you awoke Froslass with Crabominable & Abomasnow if you keep following the path, you will interrupt a conversation between Snom and Froslass, with Snom hanging down on some thread

Froslass will appear if you lure Crabominable over to the tree, hit it with an Illumina orb to knock snow onto Abomasnow. This causes a snowstorm where a blizzard will appear. Photograph Froslass and it'll lead you into the Icy Cave. Beyond that, if you keep following the path, you will interrupt a conversation between Snom and Froslass and Froslass will vanish into the snow. If you hit Snom with a fluffruit, Froslass will move through the caves and keep stopping for more Snom. Hit them again and it will lead Froslass to the final area, where she will sleep above you. She and can be woken with Melody for a 4 star photo
Icy Snow Pattern Vivillon can be spotted immediately in the Icy Cave when you enter it. It will fly around and land on the walls. A small group of Icy Snow Vivillon can also be seen in the distance

Aurorus appears in the Icy Cave path by the final exit. First there will be one frozen in ice. If you awaken the Jynx and lead it over to the Crystabloom with fluffruit then, when there throw an Illumina orb at the Crystabloom, the Jynx will both cause the Aurorus to break out of the ice for a 4 star picture. It will be walking along the iceberg. If you throw a fluffruit, it will eat it and its fins will change colour. If you woke the other Aurorus, a second one will appear
Avalugg has two appearances in the Icy Cave Path. The first has it come out of the water and onto land and the second has it in the distance carrying a Jynx
Dewgong is in the coastal part of the Icy Cave path and will be in the water before jumping onto an iceberg

Cubchoo appears in two parts of the Icy Cave Path. First it's in the cave on the side to the right where two will be playing and walking about. The next CUbchoo is in the coastal area where it is sleeping on the iceberg with a Beartic

Beartic is in two parts of the coastal part of the Icy Cave Path. First there's one sitting on an iceberg watching a sleeping Cubchoo and another will jump onto the Iceberg and help watch. Behind them is another Beartic which is fully lying down asleep. If you throw fluffruit into the small hole next to the sleeping Beartic, Magikarp will jump out. If you wake Beartic up, it will chase Magikap and jump in for a 4 star picture
Magikarp appears in the shoreside part of the stage. If you throw fluffruit into the small hole next to the sleeping Beartic, Magikarp will jump out. If you wake Beartic up, it will chase Magikap

In the Snow Path area, you will spot a Glaceon sleeping in the snow. If you hit it with an Illumina orb, it will wake up and run about the top of the cliffs. If you keep photographing and hitting it, it will also end up near the course exit. If you hit Spheal with the fluffruit before Abomasnow hits them. Photograph Glaceon's move for a 4 star photo

To activate Suicune, you need to have finished the story. Then, when you go through the coastal part of the Icy Cave path, you'll see a Jynx riding an Avalugg. Throw an Illumina orb at it and it'll summon Suicune who will run in on the water. It will run across the icerbergs and will occasionally stop to greet Pokémon such as Delibird for choice photo opportunities. If you hit it with a Illumina orb when running and hit it when it's stopped, it'll use Blizzard

Crobat will fly around the start of this stage, flying at the moon and in the big wide open cave area. Later, a couple of Crobat can be seen in the final part of the standard path. In this part, they are fighting with some Rampardos.
