If you Throw two Illumina orbs at the Crobat in the distance at the end of the standard path of the cave and Photograph its acts for a 4 star photo In the path down to the Gemstone path, you can throw fluffruit at the big stalactite. If you hit it in the right place, it will fall down, waking Crobat up

Carbink can be seen in a variety of places. First to the direct left, you will be able to see some with a Pumpkaboo. You can see two moving near a Gengar portal. Hit them with Illumina orbs and Gengar will appear and startle them. Then, in research Lv. 2 you can see some being chased by Drifloon as you go down into the cave. Other times they are on various gem stones. In the Gemstone path, in research Lv. 3 you will see a pair of Carbink with a Mawile. Throw Illumina orbs and they will summon Diancie. Later, more Carbink appears within the garden area in the standard route. If you hit the Crystablooms, some will come out. Play the melody then you can get a 4 Star reaction from them

Joltik appears in many places throughout this stage, clinging to rocks. In the final garden if you take the secret route in, you can lure Joltik to jump onto Jolteon for a 4 star shot and lure Joltik onto the electric spikes towards the end for it to use its electricity for another
Braviary can be seen sleeping on top of a rock in the main part of the cave. It can also be seen flying if you look up towards the moon

Rampardos appears at the end of the standard path. It will be seen fighting with the Crobat but the fight can be interrupted. Slightly further on, another Rampardos can be seen alone near a Gengar portal. If you lure Rampardos to the portal, then it will charge at it and hit the wall creating a 4 star opportunity for Rampardos, Geodude and Gengar. A Rampardos can also be found sleeping in the Garden area
In research Lv. 1 & 2, Glalie appears sleeping in the way down the cave

Magikarp appears in the main cave area if you hit the Crystablooms by the waterfall. This will summon two Magikarp for photo opportunities If you go down the Rimstone Path, you'll be able to find another Magikarp. If you throw an Illumina orb at the place where it says there's something in the water, a Magikarp will come out. If you keep throwing Illumina orbs at it, Magikarp will keep flopping until it gets between Goodra and Noibat, scaring the Noibat

Croagunk appears on the way down the main part of the cave to the sides. There are three Croagunk here and they can be interacted with with fluffruit. Playing the Melody causes it to sing. As you are going down the cave, hit the three Croagunk in the order: Middle, Top, Bottom. Then, they will start to float. Photograph them floating for a 4 star photo. You can also lure them to Gengar's portal to have Gengar cause mischief with them.

Sableye appears hiding behind many gems on the standard path and the Gemstone path. It also can be seen chasing Carbink and sleeping. A sleeping Sableye is a 4 star picture As you go down the standard path, lure Sableye to Geodude in a small alcove on the right. Sableye will dig under Geodude until Geodude wakes up scaring it. Photograph the scared Sableye

While in many cases, Gengar can be seen and interacted with on the normal areas, you will see various portals. If you play the music by the portals, Gengar will peer out. You can lure various Pokémon into the portal. In the first area as you go down, you will see Carbink by it. Use Illumina orbs and Gengar will scare them. With Rampardos in the final area, to cause Gengar to create mischief. There is a Gengar portal on the ceiling by a sleeping Crobat. If you use Melody, it will come out and startle the Crobat. After the Rampardos tries to attack, Gengar comes back and sticks its tongue out for a Level 4 Photo

Geodude appears in a couple of places. Normally they are stuck to the side of the walls. Slightly further on, another Rampardos can be seen alone near a Gengar portal. If you lure Rampardos to the portal, then it will charge at it and hit the wall creating a 4 star opportunity for Rampardos, Geodude and Gengar If you go down the Gemstone path, you will see two fighting. If you use an Illumina orb, you will give one the advantage over the other

Noibat appears starting in research Lv. 2 and can lead you to the Gemstone Path. From research Lv. 3, they will appear throughout the stage flying around. You will find two at the start leading you into the path. In the right of the main area, by the waterfalls, there are a couple of small caves. If you throw fluffruit in, you can lure Noibat out. One will even go to the Magikarp if you have released it by using the Crystabloom and will sometimes use its sound moves. A trio of Noibat will also fly out if you throw Illumina orbs towards the lefthand path In the main path, you will find a giant cave hole. If you use an Illumina orb in the Crystablooms in the entrance, a load of Noibat will fly out. Further on, some Noibat can be seen playing with Goodra. If you can go down the Rimstone Path, you can lure Magikarp out and interrupt them, causing Noibat to be scared for another top picture In the Gemstone Path, you will find some Noibat playing on the floor of the garden at the end. You can feed them fluffruit for photos in this part
Vivillon Jungle Pattern can be seen throughout the garden part of the stage

Drifloon appears throughout this stage. Some will attack some Carbink in research Lv. 2 or Joltik in research Lv. 3 to try and carry them away. You will also see more as you move down the Gemstone Path and the Rimstone Path and if you hit the Crystabloom by them, they will overinflate for a 4 star photo

Mawile appears in the Gemstone path. One is standing on a pillar of rock and will start going aggressive against you. Another can be seen between multiple gemstones. From research Lv. 3 reach, a Mawile can be seen at the bottom of that area. If you light it and the Carbink up with Illumina Energy, Diancie will appear and will then do a show. This will calm the Mawile down and you can interact with it by feeding it fluffruit and will offer you an alternate path Another Mawile appears in the garden area at the bottom of the path

There are a few places to find Clefairy. The first is talking with a Gengar as you go down into the cave. It will Prompt attention once Gengar disappears. After that, you will see three around a Crystablooms. Light up the Crystablooms for a good shot. If you use Melody, they will start to dance. Hit them with Illumina orbs and they will float in the air. Finally, when you're on the path to the end, you'll see a large cave mouth where two Clefairy are sleeping. If you hit the Crystablooms in the cave entrance, it will wake the Clefairy up and Melody will have them dance for another 4 star photo
A Beartic can be spotted at the top of the entire cave when you enter the big crevice

An Average Size Pumpkaboo appears by looking immediately to the left alongside some Carbink and in the distance in the far right of the start of the stage beyond a Carink. A third appears as you go down the Gemstone Path. Itwill be in the rocks behind you. Another appears towards the bottom of the jungle area in the cave. If you hit it with an Illumina orb, it will set off its searchlights

A Large Size Pumpkaboo appears as you enter the main cave. If you turn left and up, you will see it along the cliff face. Hitting it with an Illumina orb will set its search lights off. If you go the secret path after calming Mawile with Diancie's show, you may find another Large Size Pumpkaboo here

A Small Size Pumpkaboo appears towards the end of the standard path. As you go alongside the Rimstone, if you turn left you will see the Small Size Pumpkaboo If you go the secret path after calming Mawile with Diancie's show, you may find another Small Size Pumpkaboo here

The Super Size Pumpkaboo requires a bit of work to get. To Prompt it, you need to throw Illumina orbs at the three Average Pumpkaboo and the one large Pumpkaboo on the way down to the special garden. Then, throw Illumina orbs at Mawile and two Carbink to Prompt Diancie to appear and throw an Illumina orb at it to Prompt it to perform. If you manage to hit all three and awaken Diancie, the Average Size Pumpkaboo there will be replaced with a Super Size Pumpkaboo which is a guaranteed 4 star photo

In research Lv. 3, Hydreigon appears flying down the big crevice at the midpoint of the level. It then follows down the standard path where it will also start to rage. In the final chamber of the standard path, when Hydreigon starts to lower itself, play Melody and it will go down to the water. Throw a fluffruit near it when it's in the water and it will eat it. Photograph it eating for a 4 Star Photo Hit Hydreigon twice with fluffruit on its way down into the cave for a 3 Star Photo. Then, when you reach the end of the stage, hit it with another one for another reaction for 4 Stars

Goodra appears along the standard path. There is a large cave part way through and if you hit the Crystablooms, it will light up and Goodra will Prompt happy and excited. Further along, in the Rimstone area, Goodra can be seen splashing the water with Noibat. If you go on the Rimstone Path, you can activate the 4 Star pose using an Illumina orb where it says there's a Pokémon in the water. This lures a Magikarp out. Keep hitting it with Illumina orbs and it will come between the playful Goodra and Noibat causing Noibat to Prompt scared. This will anger Goodra and it'll splash with its tail to knock Magikarp back

Requires you to awaken Diancie in the hidden path, then take a new hidden path to the back of the hidden cave. You can lure a Joltik over to the Jolteon and it will latch on, causing Jolteon to have to utilise its electricity to shake Joltik off creating its 4 star photo. It jumping out is its 3 star photo

Vivillon Archipelago Pattern can be spotted in the special garden area if you take the alternate path by activating Diancie's powers. It can be seen in the far distance. It can also be summoned on the standard path using Illumina orbs to the left as you enter the garden

Diancie appears in the Cave in research Lv. 3 when you move down to the alternate path. You'll find Carbink and Mawile on the ground. Throw Illumina orbs at them and Diancie will appear In the Garden, throw an Illumina orb out to Prompt the Carbink into the main area. Then, when all 4 Carbink ar in the area press Melody and get them to dance. This will summon Diancie. Hit it with a Illumina orb to generate a Diamond and photograph the response shoot

Steelix is the fifth Illumina Pokémon to encounter. Steelix will dart from cave to cave, often needing to be taunted out using fluffruit. Its appearances are often fleeting requiring some quick reflexes with the Illumina orbs On subsequent visits, several Pokémon will interact with Steelix, changing its attack patterns. If you awaken the Crobat, if you only awaken the right one, it will be using Iron Tail for a 4 star photo opportunity, if you awaken both or the left one, it will bite into rocks. If you awaken neither, you will get it sleeping at the end for another 4 Star Photo

Noibat will fly through the start of the stage and various other parts to give indications of where Steelix will be. At the end, if you have awakened the Crobat and helped Steelix fight it off, either through intimidation or use of Iron Tail, a solitary Noibat will be seen cheering with the Steelix for a 4 star picture
Carbink appears resting on rocks in the early part of the stage. It will disappear and run for cover as Steelix breaks through. It can also be found in the ruins

Sableye appears resting on rocks in the early part of the stage. It will disappear and run for cover as Steelix breaks through. It can also be found in the ruins. In the ruins, lure the Sableye together with a fluffruit. Photograph the Sableye together for a 4 Star photo
Joltik appears resting on rocks in the early part of the stage. It will disappear and run for cover as Steelix breaks through. It can also be found in the ruins.

In the front of the stage, throw an Illumina orb at Noibat and wait for Steelix to stick its head out of the cave. Noibat will Supersonic and Crobat will fly out. In the bridge chamber, Crobat can be summoned in the stage by lighting up some Crystabloomss while also making sure Steelix is active or on the right sleeping in an alcove. It will have a face off with Steelix part way through the stage

Houndoom is the guard of the Ruins and appears at the front of the stage. In early Levels they will react to your presence with anger but at research Lv. 3 you will find them sleeping and be generally more personable.

Eldegoss appears in two areas of the stage. First you will find a group floating around in front of the ruins outside. If you hit them with the Illumina orb or a Crystablooms then they will spin harder and may even release some cotton if you lure a Natu near them. In the internal part of the ruins, you will see 3 Eldegoss gathered around a Crystablooms. If you hit them with Illumina orbs, you will then be able to Prompt them to move

Natu appears in the ruins in two ways. In research Lv. 1, if you throw fluffruit at the ruins, it will come out and perch itself on the fluffruit and photograph the response. research Lv. 2 onwards you can Prompt a Natu out of the cliffside to the left using fluffruit at it. It can interact with Eldegoss here for a 4 Star Eldegoss Natu appears perched on a Golurk inside the ruins. It can be awakened with the Illumina orb where it'll jump off and then find some friends

Beheeyem appears inside the ruins and will be using its powers. Later on in the stage, one appears around a Golurk that won't awaken unless you hit every Crystablooms in the stage. At research Lv. 3, you will also find a Beheeyem asleep floating around

Salandit has a couple of appearances. Its first appearance is as ytou enter the ruins. In research Lv. 1, one will run away from you while at research Lv. 2, you will have 3 appear and they'll face off against a Houndoom. Finally at research Lv. 3, you need to move the Noivern for it to come out. Another Salandic an be seen inside the ruins. You will come across some battle scarred area and can lure Salandit out to it where it will have a battle with Noivern for a 4 star photo
Noivern appears as you enter the ruins. It will dance if you hit itwith an Illumina orb. When you're in the ruins itself, you will be able to see some Noivern flying around
Sigilyph can be seen in the internal parts of the ruins moving around and taking guard. After it sees you, it will use various attacks in your direction which make for good photo opportunities

Golurk appears around the internal part of the ruins. You will see them walking around the area standing guard, but they will react to fluffruit and Illumina orbs When you reach research Lv. 3, as you start the stage and reach the ruins, two Golurk will be seen flying overhead for another 4 star photo opportunity. In the ruins, Prompt the two Beheeyem to meet using fluffruit at the first, then again after it moves Golurk. Then, two Golurk will fly into the ruins.
Chandelure can be seen in Research research Lv. 2 flying around the internals of the ruins

In research Lv. 2, you will find Absol in the main part of the ruins on the ground where it will interact with you more. In research Lv. 3 reach, you will find it outside of the ruins when you use Melody. It will come from a cliffside to the left and then jump down into the ruins. You will see it throughout the internals of the ruins including around a spot where it will fight with Salandit if properly lured together

Woobat appears through a simple element of throwing a fluffruit into a well as you are about to enter the main part of the ruins. It will fly upwith Illumina Energy before affixing itself to a wall inside. From research Lv. 3, when you go to enter the ruins, a cauldron of Woobat will fly up at you.
Magikarp appears using multiple fluffruit into the well where Woobat appears.

Umbreon appears in research Lv. 3 of the Ruins. When you help the Salandit exit the area at the front of the ruins and hit it with an Illumina orb, Umbreon will quickly follow and jump into the main part of the ruins. As you go through the ruins, you will see Umbreon walking and playing, able to be affected by Illumina orbs and fluffruit. Its 4 Star interaction has it growling at Absol

Vivillon's Continental Pattern appears near the course exit. If you have hit every single Crystablooms in the stage, when you near the end look behind you and three Vivillon will be flying towards you

Complete the game and it'll appear at the start and will be able to Prompt a special interaction when hit with an Illumina orb. When you're inside the ruins, you will find another Jirachi sitting on top of the purple pillar. If you hit it with 2 Illumina orbs, it will wake up and fly off to the left. If you then activate all the Crystablooms in the ruins, it will fly towards the pillar of light. If you play the music, Jirachi will start dancing around the pillar of light. Do it again and it'll come to you and will have a magical wish which activates its 4 star photo opportunity

Xerneas is the final Illumina Pokémon, the mysterious sixth hidden one on the small island of Aurus Island. Having worn itself out 2,000 years prior protecting the region, it lay dormant until you awoke the other Illumina Pokémon. As such, it chooses to test you. It flies around in an energy orb requiring you to throw Illumina orbs at it before it takes its true form On subsequent visits, several Pokémon will inhabit the ruins alongside Xerneas. They won't attack but will be part of many photoesque images. The 4 star picture has it using Geomancy if stopped between the two Houndoom if they're awake and howling
Sigilyph can be seen relaxing in the gaps between the first path towards Xerneas. Photograph it and it flies away. More can be seen sleeping in the distance in other areas
Woobat is first seen flying out of the first room where you find Xerneas as you enter. Another set appears flying by the walls

Eldegoss appears floating in the corner of the second room where Xerneas jumps in and out of the water. One is also sitting by the water but, when Xerneas spawns and sets off its light, it gets knocked off and starts floating around
Chandelure appears in the corner to the left of the room after the room with water

Houndoom appears in multiple parts of the stage, typically sleeping next to Crystablooms. If you wake it up, you can lure it to make Xerneas use Geomancy. If you make it Howl with scan, you will get its 4 star picture
If photos are timed right, Absol will come in within the part of the stage with the two sleeping Houndoom
Noivern appears flying between various stages of the level with one sitting on a branch leaving it open for a decent photograph if Illumina orbs are used
Natu appears sleeping on various rocks or next to Xerneas and Umbreon
Golurk appears within the Illumina Spot if you throw fluffruit at Sigilyph, it will move to the next chamber. Throw another and it will summon Golurk who will fly in for a 4 star photo

photoCues.procedure: Once you enter the cave take the alternate path to the right. Just ahead in the small volcano you go through before entering the room with the blue lava look off the edge of the path to the right and you will see 2 Charmander. Hit them both with illumina orbs and then knock the Graveler above it off the wall. This will make Charizard pop through the lava and fly off forward. Head into the final area and throw fluffruit at the Typhlosion to scare them off and then throw an illumina orb at the Charizard circling above. It will land and roar, after this it will start to walk around. From here you can feed it a fluffruit, take a picture while it is eating for this pose.
photoCues.courseScope: volcano

photoCues.procedure: From the start of the level when you make your way into the first tunnel throw a fluffruit in the second hole on the right and hit Steelix with an illumina orb as it pops out. Throw a fluffruit into the hole it just dug into and it will appear from the hole above it and drop straight down, throw another illumina orb at it. In the open area right after throw an illumina orb at the hanging Crobat in the bottom right hole on the right side and it will fly forward. In the next area you will see a big hole to the left with Crystals lining the bottom. Throw a fluffruit in and start throwing illumina orbs right away to hit the Steelix. If hit enough it will pop out of the hole and fight the Crobat. After fighting the Crobat it will pop out one more time and slither over to a Noibat and cheer happily with the Noibat. This is its 2 star pose.

If you keep following through, you'll see two Crystablooms before the very end to the right. If you succeeded in reuniting Deerling & Sawsbuck, they will run ahead, activating them both and you'll Prompt the path to the Sunny Plains, which will contain Pokémon from the areas you have been to

features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in the Undersea Path as you are going down into the depths. There is a Lumineon and two Finneon on it which will Prompt attacked by a Sharpedo. Activate the Crystabloom in order to help the Lumineon fight off the Sharpedo

features.name: Crystabloom 4
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in the Undersea Cave path in the Lugia's Den area. It is in front of Lugia and if activated, slightly awakens Lugia

features.name: Crystabloom 5
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in the Undersea Cave path in the Lugia's Den area. It is in the distance behind Lugia with a Magikarp next to it. If activated, it will awaken Lugia

features.name: Crystabloom 6
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in the Undersea Cave path within the ruins. If Tentacruel has been lured here in research Lv. 2, or Starmie in research Lv. 3, activating it will cause them to dance.

features.name: Crystabloom 7
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in standard path. A Lumineon is sleeping on it and needs to be hit by a fluffruit in order to gain access to it

features.name: Crystabloom 8
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in standard path. As you start to move back up to the surface you will see it. Activate it and two Luvdisc will come to the area

features.name: Crystabloom 9
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in standard path. As you start to move back up to the surface you will see it. Activate it and four Luvdisc will come to the area. Play Melody and they will turn on their side

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found to the left before Wishiwashi will start doing its Whirlpool animation

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found to the right Wishiwashi will start doing its Whirlpool animation

features.name: Oasis Path
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 2 This path is originally blocked in research Lv. 1, but from research Lv. 2 it is automatically opened up and gives an alternate path around the Oasis, matching the default path of Sands (Night)

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find a trio of Crystabloom towards the start of the stage. If you hit all three, the twister will end and Flygon will appear from it

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found towards the end of the first path and is by a Silicobra

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in the right path on the rockface by a Mandibuzz. You can lure Lycanroc there and hit it to make sure Lycanroc continues on to the end of the path to howl

features.name: Crystabloom 4
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in the middle of the Oasis

features.name: Crystabloom 5
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found to the right as you go down the sandfall

features.name: Oasis Path
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 2 This path is originally blocked in research Lv. 1, but from research Lv. 2 it is automatically opened up and gives an alternate path around the Oasis, matching the default path of Sands (Day)

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find a trio of Crystabloom towards the start of the stage. If you hit all three, then two Minior will fly in to the area

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found towards the end of the left path and is by a Twister. Activate it and it will summon a Tyranitar

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in the right path on the rockface

features.name: Crystabloom 4
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found in the middle of the Oasis. If you light it up, then the Oasis will glow

features.name: Crystabloom 5
features.procedure: This Crystabloom is found to the right as you go down the sandfall

features.name: Blue Magma
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 3 This path is originally blocked in research Lv. 1, and your default in research Lv. 2, but in research Lv. 3 you'll have the ability of choosing to go down the path to the Blue Magma chamber and the ancient ruins

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears at the end of the standard path

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears at the end of the Blue Magma Path. Sometimes, Typhlosion will go in and out of it

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the canyon area. In early Levels you can light it to power up a Monferno

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the canyon area to the right. A Charmander is by it and will pose for a special shot. Sometimes, Ho-Oh will fly overhead

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the volcano area above Tyrantrum. Activate it and throw fluffruit towards the end to finish the game of Hide & Seek with Charmander

features.name: Crystabloom 4
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Blue Magma path. Activate it and it'll illuminate the blue magma and awaken all nearby Pokémon

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears right near the course entrance, behind you

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the second chamber. If you light it, it will often attract Volcarona to you

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the second chamber. A pair of Archeops will fly to this when activated for a decent photo before attacking the Volcarona

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the second chamber. If both Volcarona are activated at this point, they may fly around and dance around the Crystabloom

features.name: Geyser Path
features.procedure: Unlock Level : In the start of the stage, if you throw an Illumina orb at the Crystabloom early enough, it will knock a rock into a geyser and allow for you to take the alternate path up the cliffs that takes you up a geyser and along the cliffside. This path can only be followed in Levels 2 and 3

features.name: Geyser Path
features.procedure: Unlock Level : In the start of the stage, if you throw an Illumina orb at 2 of the Diglett in the area and Photograph them, then throw an Illumina orb at the Crystabloom, the Diglett will knock the rock into the geyser and you will be able to go on the alternate path. This path can only be activated in research Lv. 2

features.name: Snow Wall
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 2 This path is a tricky one to find. In research Lv. 2, near to where you start, you'll see an Alolan Sandslash. If you photograph it, it will dig under and reappear slightly later in the area. Photograph it again and it will reappear by a snow wall and dig through. After that, it will be forever accessible

features.name: Icy Cavern
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 2 This path is in the blizzard area after the Snow Wall and requires activating in Snowfields (Night) and leads to the Icy Cavern and a shore. After activating, it is permanently accessible

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears within the Icy Cave

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Forest area. If you activate it, a Furret will jump out

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Tundra between the ice sheets, but you can never really reach it

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the cave. Activating it awakens Glalie & Froslass

features.name: Crystabloom 4
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the final area of the standard path. Activating it activates a hot spring geyser, which you can lure Swinub to

features.name: Crystabloom 5
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom beyond the Snow Wall. Activating it attracts a Frosmoth into the area

features.name: Crystabloom 6
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Icy Cave in front of the frozen Aurorus

features.name: Snow Wall
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 2 This path is in the first area, just before the first cave, and is only opened up by opening it in Snowfields (Day)

features.name: Icy Cavern
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 2 Just beyond the Snow Wall you will see a Crabominable. As it moves to a new tree to punch, if you use an Illumina orb it will hit a tree harder, causing snow to fall on a sleeping Abomasnow. When the Abomasnow awakens, it will summon a Froslass slightly further on. Photograph it and it'll go to disappear behind another Snow Wall and lead you to a cave and the shoreline. After this, it is permanently accessible

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears within the Icy Cave

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Forest area

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Tundra between the ice sheets with two Jynx by it. Activate it for the Jynx to dance. It also activates lots of beams of light on the horizon

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the cave. Activating it causes Jynx and Vanilluxe to dance

features.name: Crystabloom 4
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the final area of the standard path.

features.name: Crystabloom 5
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom beyond the Snow Wall.

features.name: Crystabloom 6
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Icy Cave in front of the frozen Aurorus. Lure a second Jynx to it and activate it to Prompt the Jynx to dance and awaken Aurorus

features.name: Rimstone Path
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 3 This path is on the standard path of the stage. If you wake up the sleeping Crobat on your left, and then lure Gengar out of its upsidedown portal through Melody, behind a sleeping Crobat, the Crobat will no longer appear by the water angering the Rampardos. This gives you an alternate path. It has to be activated every time

features.name: Underground Flowers
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 3 This path is a unique one. In research Lv. 3, in the Crystal area you will be able to Prompt Diancie to appear by utilising Illumina orbs on Mawile and Carbink. This will calm another Mawile and open up a path to go the other way into the underground cave. it needs to be activated each time

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears within the garden down the Gemstone Path, and have numerous Carbink behind them

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the main chamber to the far right. If you activate it, three Magikarp will jump out

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the main chamber to the left. From research Lv. 3, 3 Clefairy will be around it. Activate Melody and hit the Crystabloom with an Illumina orb for them to dance. Hit it again and they will dance in the air

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the standard path to the left. If you activate it, the area will light up and Noibat will fly out of it

features.name: Crystabloom 4
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Rimstone Path on one of the Rimstone Pools. Activating it will over inflate all the nearby Drifloon

features.name: Crystabloom 5
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom hidden to the left between the gem stones. If you activate it, some more Drifloon will fly into the area

features.name: Crystabloom 6
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Garden in the Gemstone Path. If you activate it, it will lure the Carbink out

features.name: Crystabloom 7
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the Secret Path into the Garden in the Gemstone Path, but can be activated on the standard way. If you activate it, it will lure out an Archipelago Pattern Vivillon

features.name: Ruins
features.procedure: Unlock Level : research Lv. 2 This path will open up after your first visit to the Illumina Spot and contains ruins and various Pokémon

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears through the alternate path in the Illumina Spot and provides a mural of what happened 2,000 years ago

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the bridge area. If you activate it, a Crobat will fly out and will cause trouble for the Steelix, including making it hit its head for a 4 Star Photo

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in a cave to the right

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom at the end of the main path and will be where Steelix and Noibat will have a chat after the battle with Crobat

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears near the course entrance. Throw a fluffruit at it to lure a Natu out

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom right as you go towards the ruins. Activating it near Eldegoss will cause them to have an animation

features.name: Crystabloom 2
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom right as you go towards the path into the ruins

features.name: Crystabloom 3
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom right by the Meganium statue in the ruins

features.name: Crystabloom 4
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom right by the Wishiwashi statue in the ruins

features.name: Crystabloom 5
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom right between two rocks near the Milotic statue in the ruins

features.name: Crystabloom 6
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom right behind some Eldegoss by the Volcarona statue. Hit the Eldegoss with an orb to move them to hit it

features.name: Crystabloom 7
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom right behind Golurk. Hit it with an Illumina orb for it to move out of the way. It activates the Steelix statue

features.name: Crystabloom 8
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in a small clearing with other Crystabloom. The other Crystabloom will activate if you activate the others throughout the ruins. Then, activate the one in the middle to open a beam of light

features.name: Ancient Ruins
features.procedure: These ruins appears in the main chamber and provide a mural of what happened 2,000 years ago. You can Prompt Xerneas to use Geomancy in front of it for high points

features.name: Crystabloom 1
features.procedure: You can find this Crystabloom in the main chamber next to a sleeping Houndoom. Activate it to help activate the Houndoom and Xerneas to Prompt Xerneas to use Geomancy

unlocks.name: Monochrome
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to change the colour scheme of the photo to greyscale. Offers a scale from minimal colours to no colours

unlocks.name: Antique
unlocks.requirement: Earn research title: Ruler of the Deep Sea
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to change the colour scheme to match photos from times passed, giving it a Sepia Tone. Allows for you to alter the strength of the image

unlocks.name: Cool
unlocks.effect: Adds a blue tint to the image, with a scale from minimal contrast to maximum

unlocks.name: Contrast
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to adjust the contrast of the image, with a scale from minimal contrast in the colours to maximum

unlocks.name: Exposed
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to adjust the lighting exposure on the image, with a scale from minimal exposure to maximum

unlocks.name: Light
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to adjust the brightness of the image, with a scale from

unlocks.name: Black-and-White
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to make your photo be Black & White, with a toggle to adjust the effect

unlocks.name: Tabloid
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to make your photo look like it was from a newspaper. You can adjust the brightness of the image and also the strength of the print lines to make it look like it was printed in it

unlocks.name: High Contrast
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to alter the contrast of the image to give focus on the shadows, with a scale from high to maximum

unlocks.name: Cel Shaded
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to alter the colouring on the image to look more like a cartoon, with a scale on the level of filter, which reduces thecolour

unlocks.name: Comic
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to alter the image to look like it was in a comic book. You can adjust the size of the dots and the amount of colours allowed

unlocks.name: Dot Overlay
unlocks.requirement: Earn research title: Pinnacle of Beauty
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to add a dot overlay to the image, from minimal dots to maximum dots

unlocks.name: Pop
unlocks.requirement: Earn research title: Banquet of Fire
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to change the image so that the colours pop out more to look like a stylised piece of art

unlocks.name: Fish-Eye Lens
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to change the image so that the focus shifts as if it was being taken through a fish-eye lens, with the filter altering how much it is warped

unlocks.name: Miniature
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to change the image so that it looks like it was taken using models. Allows for you to adjust the blur strength and range

unlocks.name: Hand Colored
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to change the image so that it looks like it was painted

unlocks.name: Pixelated
unlocks.requirement: Earn research title: Grand Research Team
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to make take the image look pixellated, allowing for you to scale it from many pixels to few

unlocks.name: TV
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to add scanlines to the image as if it's being watched on an old TV

unlocks.name: Split into 16
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to split the image so there's 16

unlocks.name: Split into 4
unlocks.effect: Allows for you to split the image so there's 4
